jobs.title: Senior Lead - Tooling Engineer
jobs.description:
In short

As the Senior Lead of Footwear Tooling Engineering, you will define the strategic vision and direct the engineering execution for the bottom units of On’s high-performance footwear. Working in a highly collaborative environment, you will lead a team of tooling engineers to shape the future direction of our pinnacle performance products and technologies, actively advancing On’s sustainability and innovation goals.

You will act as the overarching authority on bottom unit development, bridging the gap between On Labs in Zurich and our Tooling and Manufacturing partners in Asia. From concept inception through commercialization, you will guide your team and cross-functional partners on bottom unit materials, complex geometries, and construction. Beyond daily development, you will be the primary driver for organizational process improvements, budget management, and long-term capability building for tooling across the company.

Your mission

• Technical Direction: Direct the holistic bottom unit development strategy for On’s performance and lifestyle products, serving as the ultimate technical authority on materials, mold construction, and advanced manufacturing capabilities.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the strategic engineering partner to senior leadership across Design, Development, and Product Management, guiding teams through complex design and construction constraints to achieve pinnacle biomechanical performance.

• Process & Workflow Transformation: Spearhead structural workflow evaluations, establishing macro-level process improvements to maximize global efficiencies, accelerate prototyping, and advance testing protocols.

• Manufacturing & Technology Strategy: Leverage deep expertise in advanced performance foam technologies and tooling constructions to act as the primary technical advisor to product creation teams. Guide Design, Development, and Product Management on design feasibility, manufacturing capabilities, and the successful integration of next-generation midsole components.

• Global Partnership: Drive strategic partnerships with our Asian tooling counterparts and tier-1 mold shop teams, elevating collaboration models and proactively resolving high-level manufacturing concerns and tooling revisions.

• Quality & Standards: Establish best-in-class standards for manufacturability and durability, overseeing the team's review of 2D/3D CADs and physical prototypes to ensure strict alignment with product specifications.

Your story

• Brand Experience: Proven track record working directly within a global performance athletic footwear brand. You must possess a deep understanding of the brand-side product creation lifecycle, consumer expectations, and how to align technical engineering with overarching brand strategies.

• Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in footwear engineering, specifically focused on footwear tooling, bottom unit development, and production.

• Technical Authority: Expert-level knowledge of footwear materials, advanced mold construction, and manufacturing processes. Deep mastery of plastics injection molding principles, structural design constraints, and tooling cost analysis.

• Software Proficiency: Strong background overseeing or executing 2D and 3D CAD work (Rhino, SolidWorks, etc.), 3D modeling, and rapid prototyping tools.

• Biomechanical Application: Extensive experience translating biomechanical performance principles into functional, manufacturable bottom unit designs.

• Strategic & Collaborative Mindset: Proven ability to influence cross-functional directors and leads across Design, Product Management, and Testing.

• Global Communication: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of successfully navigating and negotiating with international manufacturing partners on complex tooling and production challenges.

• Agility: Excellent project management and resource allocation skills, with the ability to manage multiple overlapping timelines and departmental priorities.

• Travel: Available to travel to Asia up to 2-4 times a year for strategic factory and mold shop visits.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

Come Senior Lead of Footwear Tooling Engineering, definirete la visione strategica e dirigere l'esecuzione ingegneristica per le unità di fondo delle calzature ad alte prestazioni di On. Lavorando in un ambiente altamente collaborativo, guiderai un team di ingegneri di strumenti per modellare la direzione futura dei nostri prodotti e tecnologie di performance di pinnacle, promuovendo attivamente gli obiettivi di sostenibilità e innovazione di On.

Agirà come autorità di controllo sullo sviluppo delle unità di fondo, colmare il divario tra i laboratori di Zurigo e i nostri partner di Tooling e Manufacturing in Asia. Dall'inizio del concetto attraverso la commercializzazione, guiderai il tuo team e partner interfunzionali sui materiali delle unità inferiori, geometrie complesse e costruzione. Al di là dello sviluppo quotidiano, sarete il principale driver per i miglioramenti di processo organizzativi, la gestione del bilancio e la costruzione di capacità a lungo termine per lo strumento in tutta l'azienda.

La tua missione

• Direzione Tecnica: Dirigere la strategia di sviluppo unitaria inferiore olistica per i prodotti di performance e lifestyle di On, servendo come ultima autorità tecnica sui materiali, la costruzione di stampi e le capacità di produzione avanzate.

• Leadership cross-Functional: Agite come partner di ingegneria strategica per la leadership senior in Design, Sviluppo e Product Management, guidando i team attraverso complessi vincoli di progettazione e costruzione per raggiungere prestazioni biomeccaniche pinnacle.

• Process & Workflow Transformation: Spearhead valutazioni del flusso di lavoro strutturale, che stabilisce miglioramenti del processo a livello macro per massimizzare le efficienze globali, accelerare la prototipazione e i protocolli di test anticipati.

• Manufacturing & Technology Strategy: Leverage profonda competenza nelle tecnologie avanzate di schiuma e nelle costruzioni di utensili per agire come consulente tecnico primario per i team di creazione di prodotti. Progettazione, sviluppo e gestione dei prodotti sulla fattibilità del design, le capacità di produzione e l'integrazione di componenti di intersuola di nuova generazione.

• Partenariato globale: guidare partnership strategiche con le nostre controparti utensili asiatiche e tier-1 team di stampi, elevando modelli di collaborazione e risolvendo in modo proattivo le preoccupazioni di produzione di alto livello e le revisioni di utensili.

• Qualità & Standards: Stabilire standard di qualità per la manufacturability e la durabilità, supervisionando la revisione del team di CAD 2D/3D e prototipi fisici per garantire un rigoroso allineamento con le specifiche del prodotto.

La tua storia

• Brand Experience: Proven track record lavorando direttamente all'interno di un marchio globale di calzature atletiche. È necessario possedere una profonda comprensione del ciclo di vita della creazione di prodotti di marca, aspettative dei consumatori, e come allineare l'ingegneria tecnica con le strategie di marca overarching.

• Esperienza: 10+ anni di esperienza progressiva nell'ingegneria calzaturiera, specificamente focalizzata sull'attrezzo di calzature, sullo sviluppo delle unità di fondo e sulla produzione.

• Autorità Tecnica: Conoscenza a livello di esperti dei materiali per calzature, costruzione di stampi avanzati e processi di produzione. Profondo padronanza dei principi di stampaggio ad iniezione di materie plastiche, vincoli di progettazione strutturale e analisi dei costi di utensili.

• Proficienza del software: Forte supervisione dello sfondo o esecuzione del lavoro CAD 2D e 3D (Rhino, SolidWorks, ecc.), modellazione 3D e strumenti di prototipazione rapida.

• Applicazione biomeccanica: Esperienza estesa che traduce i principi di performance biomeccanici in progetti funzionali e manufacturable bottom unit.

• Mindset strategico e collaborativo: comprovata capacità di influenzare direttori interfunzionali e conduce attraverso Design, Product Management e Testing.

• Comunicazione globale: competenze comunicative eccezionali con un track record di navigazione e negoziazione con i partner di produzione internazionali su complesse sfide di lavorazione e produzione.

• Agility: Ottima gestione del progetto e capacità di allocazione delle risorse, con la capacità di gestire più tempi sovrapposti e priorità dipartimentali.

• Viaggi: Disponibile per viaggiare in Asia fino a 2-4 volte all'anno per visite di fabbrica e negozio di stampi strategici.

• Technical Direction: Direct the holistic bottom unit development strategy for On’s performance and lifestyle products, serving as the ultimate technical authority on materials, mold construction, and advanced manufacturing capabilities.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the strategic engineering partner to senior leadership across Design, Development, and Product Management, guiding teams through complex design and construction constraints to achieve pinnacle biomechanical performance.

• Process & Workflow Transformation: Spearhead structural workflow evaluations, establishing macro-level process improvements to maximize global efficiencies, accelerate prototyping, and advance testing protocols.

• Manufacturing & Technology Strategy: Leverage deep expertise in advanced performance foam technologies and tooling constructions to act as the primary technical advisor to product creation teams. Guide Design, Development, and Product Management on design feasibility, manufacturing capabilities, and the successful integration of next-generation midsole components.

• Global Partnership: Drive strategic partnerships with our Asian tooling counterparts and tier-1 mold shop teams, elevating collaboration models and proactively resolving high-level manufacturing concerns and tooling revisions.

• Quality & Standards: Establish best-in-class standards for manufacturability and durability, overseeing the team's review of 2D/3D CADs and physical prototypes to ensure strict alignment with product specifications.

Your story

• Brand Experience: Proven track record working directly within a global performance athletic footwear brand. You must possess a deep understanding of the brand-side product creation lifecycle, consumer expectations, and how to align technical engineering with overarching brand strategies.

• Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in footwear engineering, specifically focused on footwear tooling, bottom unit development, and production.

• Technical Authority: Expert-level knowledge of footwear materials, advanced mold construction, and manufacturing processes. Deep mastery of plastics injection molding principles, structural design constraints, and tooling cost analysis.

• Software Proficiency: Strong background overseeing or executing 2D and 3D CAD work (Rhino, SolidWorks, etc.), 3D modeling, and rapid prototyping tools.

• Biomechanical Application: Extensive experience translating biomechanical performance principles into functional, manufacturable bottom unit designs.

• Strategic & Collaborative Mindset: Proven ability to influence cross-functional directors and leads across Design, Product Management, and Testing.

• Global Communication: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of successfully navigating and negotiating with international manufacturing partners on complex tooling and production challenges.

• Agility: Excellent project management and resource allocation skills, with the ability to manage multiple overlapping timelines and departmental priorities.

• Travel: Available to travel to Asia up to 2-4 times a year for strategic factory and mold shop visits.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref

En tant que responsable principal de l'ingénierie de l'outillage de chaussures, vous définirez la vision stratégique et dirigerez l'exécution de l'ingénierie pour les unités inférieures des chaussures hautes performances On. Travaillant dans un environnement hautement collaboratif, vous dirigerez une équipe d'ingénieurs d'outillage pour façonner l'orientation future de nos produits et technologies de performance pinnacle, en faisant avancer activement les objectifs de durabilité et d'innovation.

Vous agirez en tant qu'autorité de base pour le développement des unités de base, comblant l'écart entre On Labs à Zurich et nos partenaires d'outillage et de fabrication en Asie. Depuis le début du concept jusqu'à la commercialisation, vous guiderez votre équipe et vos partenaires interfonctionnels sur les matériaux de base, les géométries complexes et la construction. Au-delà du développement quotidien, vous serez le principal moteur de l'amélioration des processus organisationnels, de la gestion budgétaire et du renforcement des capacités à long terme pour l'outillage dans toute l'entreprise.

Votre mission

• Direction technique : Diriger la stratégie globale de développement de l'unité de base pour les produits de performance et de style de vie d'On.

• Leadership interfonctionnel : Agir en tant que partenaire stratégique de l'ingénierie pour les dirigeants de la conception, du développement et de la gestion des produits, guider les équipes par des contraintes complexes de conception et de construction pour atteindre les performances biomécaniques du pinacle.

• Transformation des processus et des flux de travail : Évaluation des flux de travail structurels Spearhead, établissement d'améliorations des processus au niveau macro-économique pour maximiser l'efficacité mondiale, accélérer le prototypage et faire avancer les protocoles d'essai.

• Stratégie de fabrication et de technologie : Tirer parti d'une expertise approfondie dans les technologies avancées de mousse de performance et les constructions d'outillage pour agir comme conseiller technique principal auprès des équipes de création de produits. Guide de conception, de développement et de gestion des produits sur la faisabilité de conception, les capacités de fabrication et l'intégration réussie des composants de la nouvelle génération de semelle intermédiaire.

• Partenariat mondial : Conduire des partenariats stratégiques avec nos homologues asiatiques de l'outillage et nos équipes de magasin de moules de niveau 1, élever les modèles de collaboration et résoudre les problèmes de fabrication de haut niveau et les révisions d'outillage.

• Qualité et normes : Établir des normes de fabrication et de durabilité de qualité supérieure, superviser l'examen par l'équipe des CAO 2D/3D et des prototypes physiques pour assurer un alignement strict sur les spécifications du produit.

Votre histoire

• Expérience de la marque: Expérience éprouvée travaillant directement au sein d'une marque de chaussures sport de performance mondiale. Vous devez posséder une compréhension approfondie du cycle de vie de la création de produits côté marque, des attentes des consommateurs et de la façon d'aligner l'ingénierie technique sur les stratégies de marque.

• Expérience : plus de 10 ans d'expérience progressive en ingénierie de la chaussure, axée sur l'outillage de la chaussure, le développement de l'unité inférieure et la production.

• Autorité technique: Connaissances spécialisées des matériaux de chaussures, de la construction avancée de moules et des procédés de fabrication. Maîtrise approfondie des principes de moulage par injection de plastiques, des contraintes de conception structurelle et de l'analyse des coûts d'outillage.

• Compétence du logiciel : Forte expérience en supervision ou en exécution de travaux CAO 2D et 3D (Rhino, SolidWorks, etc.), modélisation 3D et outils de prototypage rapide.

• Application biomécanique : Expérience approfondie de la traduction des principes de performance biomécanique en conceptions fonctionnelles et manufacturables d'unités bas.

• Esprits stratégiques et collaboratifs : Capacité éprouvée d'influencer les directeurs interfonctionnels et de diriger la conception, la gestion des produits et les essais.

• Communication globale : Compétences exceptionnelles en communication avec un passé de navigation réussie et de négociation avec des partenaires industriels internationaux sur des défis complexes en matière d'outillage et de production.

• Agilité : Excellente capacité de gestion de projet et d'affectation des ressources, avec la capacité de gérer des échéances multiples et des priorités ministérielles.

• Voyage: Disponible pour voyager en Asie jusqu'à 2-4 fois par an pour des visites stratégiques d'usine et de magasin de moules.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At On, everything we do is deeply rooted in innovation at its core and more specifically when it comes to our physical products. That’s why we are looking for a Staff Software Engineer for the Product Innovation team in the Product R&D Cluster with a strong background in full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, and event-driven systems to help build the next generation of digital platforms that power Product Innovation at On.

As a key member of our innovation team, you will play a pivotal role in leading the development of pioneering digital experiences that connect with our core data platform, disruptive technologies such as LightSpray and future exploratory innovations. You will be responsible for designing and building scalable, cloud-native applications from the ground up. In addition to being hands-on, you will mentor team members, share your knowledge and expertise, and influence the technical direction of our innovation efforts.

You will be based in Zurich and are willing to be in the office two days per week . You will collaborate closely with a cross-functional team between Tech and Innovation, while serving as the go-to person for the architectural vision of this space within the broader Technology and Product Management teams across On’s global office locations.

Your Mission

• Drive the development of cutting-edge platforms and interactive web applications, using technologies such as TypeScript, Node.js, and React , that integrate seamlessly with our core event-driven architecture (Kafka) .

• Design, build, and maintain scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure on platforms like GCP or AWS , ensuring our innovative products are built on a solid foundation.

• Own technical knowledge across the full stack and infrastructure, retaining architectural context while providing guidance on modern web standards, API design, and event-driven patterns.

• Be hands-on by writing and owning production-quality code, from GraphQL APIs and streaming consumers to interactive front-ends. Setting a high bar through thoughtful PR reviews and continuously improving reliability and operability.

• Act as a technical mentor to engineers on full-stack development, cloud-native principles, and best practices for interacting with streaming data platforms like Kafka.

• Influence the technical direction of product innovation by collaborating with senior leadership, helping to establish well-designed and well-documented cloud architectures , and bringing new concepts from prototype to production.

Your Story

• 5+ years of experience building and operating large-scale, cloud-native applications in production.

• Extensive hands-on experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and React in a production environment, building both robust back-end systems and responsive, interactive front-ends.

• Extensive hands-on experience with database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL).

• Proven experience working with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and a strong understanding of infrastructure-as-code principles.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka in production, including consuming from and interacting with event streams.

• Experience leading complex technical initiatives, partnering with multiple stakeholders and teams, and providing technical direction to others.

• Experience mentoring and coaching engineers, providing guidance and feedback to support their growth and development.

Nice to haves:

• Experience building data pipelines .

• A deep understanding of 3D asset manipulation on the web (e.g., Three.js, rhino3dm).

• Previous experience in C# .NET development

descriptionByLocale.it:
A On, tutto quello che facciamo è profondamente radicato nell'innovazione al suo centro e più specificamente quando si tratta dei nostri prodotti fisici. Ecco perché siamo alla ricerca di un Staff Software Engineer per il team Product Innovation nel Product R&D Cluster con un forte background in sviluppo full-stack, infrastrutture cloud e sistemi basati su eventi per contribuire a costruire la prossima generazione di piattaforme digitali che alimentano l'innovazione del prodotto su On.

In qualità di membro chiave del nostro team di innovazione, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel guidare lo sviluppo di esperienze digitali pionieristiche che si connettono con la nostra piattaforma di dati core, tecnologie dirompenti come LightSpray e future innovazioni esplorative. Sarete responsabili per la progettazione e la costruzione di applicazioni scalabili, cloud-native da terra. Oltre ad essere pratico, tu guiderai i membri del team, condividi le tue conoscenze e competenze e influenzerai la direzione tecnica dei nostri sforzi di innovazione.

Si avrà sede a Zurigo e sono disposti ad essere in ufficio due giorni alla settimana. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con un team interfunzionale tra Tech e Innovation, mentre sarai il protagonista della visione architettonica di questo spazio all’interno dei più vasti team di Technology and Product Management di On’s global office.

La tua missione

• Guida lo sviluppo di piattaforme all'avanguardia e applicazioni web interattive, utilizzando tecnologie come TypeScript, Node.js e React , che si integrano perfettamente con la nostra architettura core event-driven (Kafka) .

• Progettare, costruire e mantenere l'infrastruttura cloud scalabile e resiliente su piattaforme come GCP o AWS, garantendo che i nostri prodotti innovativi siano costruiti su una solida base.

• Conoscenze tecniche proprie in tutto lo stack e l'infrastruttura, mantenendo il contesto architettonico, fornendo guida su moderni standard web, API design e modelli orientati agli eventi.

• Sii pratico scrivendo e possedendo il codice di qualità della produzione, dalle API GraphQL e dai consumatori in streaming ai front-end interattivi. Impostare un alto bar attraverso recensioni di PR riflessivo e migliorare continuamente l'affidabilità e l'operabilità.

• Agire come mentore tecnico per gli ingegneri sullo sviluppo full-stack, i principi di cloud-native e le migliori pratiche per interagire con le piattaforme di streaming dati come Kafka.

• Influenza la direzione tecnica dell'innovazione del prodotto collaborando con la leadership senior, aiutando a stabilire architetture cloud ben progettate e ben documentate e portando nuovi concetti dal prototipo alla produzione.

La tua storia

• 5+ anni di esperienza di costruzione e funzionamento applicazioni su larga scala, cloud-native in produzione.

• Ampia esperienza pratica con TypeScript, Node.js e React in un ambiente di produzione, costruendo sia sistemi back-end robusti che front-end reattivi e interattivi.

• Ampia esperienza pratica con i sistemi di database (ad esempio PostgreSQL).

• Provata esperienza di lavoro con piattaforme cloud (GCP, AWS) e una forte comprensione dei principi di infrastruttura-as-code.

• Esperienza pratica con Apache Kafka in produzione, tra cui consumare e interagire con i flussi di eventi.

• Sperimenta iniziative tecniche complesse, collaborando con più stakeholder e team e fornendo indicazioni tecniche ad altri.

• Esperienza di mentoring e coaching ingegneri, fornendo indicazioni e feedback per sostenere la loro crescita e lo sviluppo.

Bello da avere:

• Esperienza costruzione data pipelines .

• Una profonda comprensione della manipolazione degli asset 3D sul web (ad esempio, Three.js, rhino3dm).

• Esperienza precedente nello sviluppo di C# .NET

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei On ist alles, was wir tun, tief in der Innovation im Kern verwurzelt und genauer gesagt, wenn es um unsere physischen Produkte geht. Aus diesem Grund suchen wir einen Staff Software Engineer für das Produktinnovationsteam im Product R&D Cluster mit einem starken Hintergrund in Full-Stack-Entwicklung, Cloud-Infrastruktur und ereignisgesteuerten Systemen, um die nächste Generation digitaler Plattformen zu entwickeln, die Produktinnovation bei On unterstützen.

Als wichtiges Mitglied unseres Innovationsteams werden Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Entwicklung bahnbrechender digitaler Erlebnisse spielen, die sich mit unserer zentralen Datenplattform, disruptiven Technologien wie LightSpray und zukünftigen Sondierungsinnovationen verbinden. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, skalierbare, Cloud-native Anwendungen von Grund auf zu entwerfen und zu erstellen. Neben der praktischen Arbeit betreuen Sie die Teammitglieder, teilen Ihr Wissen und Ihre Expertise und beeinflussen die technische Ausrichtung unserer Innovationsbemühungen.

Sie werden in Zürich ansässig sein und sind bereit, zwei Tage pro Woche im Büro zu sein. Sie werden eng mit einem funktionsübergreifenden Team zwischen Tech und Innovation zusammenarbeiten und gleichzeitig als Ansprechpartner für die architektonische Vision dieses Raums in den breiteren Technologie- und Produktmanagementteams an den globalen Bürostandorten von On fungieren.

Deine Mission

• Betreiben Sie die Entwicklung von innovativen Plattformen und interaktiven Webanwendungen mit Technologien wie TypeScript, Node.js und React, die sich nahtlos in unsere ereignisgesteuerte Kernarchitektur (Kafka) integrieren.

• Design, Aufbau und Pflege einer skalierbaren und belastbaren Cloud-Infrastruktur auf Plattformen wie GCP oder AWS, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere innovativen Produkte auf einer soliden Grundlage basieren.

• Eigenes technisches Wissen über den gesamten Stack und die gesamte Infrastruktur, wobei der architektonische Kontext erhalten bleibt und gleichzeitig Leitlinien für moderne Webstandards, API-Design und ereignisgesteuerte Muster bereitgestellt werden.

• Seien Sie praktisch, indem Sie Code in Produktionsqualität schreiben und besitzen, von GraphQL-APIs und Streaming-Konsumenten bis hin zu interaktiven Frontends. Eine hohe Messlatte durch durchdachte PR-Reviews setzen und die Zuverlässigkeit und Bedienbarkeit kontinuierlich verbessern.

• Handeln Sie als technischer Mentor für Ingenieure zu Full-Stack-Entwicklung, Cloud-nativen Prinzipien und Best Practices für die Interaktion mit Streaming-Datenplattformen wie Kafka.

• Beeinflussen Sie die technische Richtung der Produktinnovation, indem Sie mit der Geschäftsleitung zusammenarbeiten, dabei helfen, gut gestaltete und gut dokumentierte Cloud-Architekturen zu etablieren und neue Konzepte vom Prototyp in die Produktion zu bringen.

Deine Geschichte

• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von großen, Cloud-nativen Anwendungen in der Produktion.

• Umfangreiche praktische Erfahrung mit TypeScript, Node.js und React in einer Produktionsumgebung, die sowohl robuste Backend-Systeme als auch reaktionsschnelle, interaktive Frontends erstellt.

• Umfangreiche praktische Erfahrung mit Datenbanksystemen (z.B. PostgreSQL).

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Cloud-Plattformen (GCP, AWS) und ein starkes Verständnis der Infrastructure-as-Code-Prinzipien.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit Apache Kafka in der Produktion, einschließlich des Konsumierens von und der Interaktion mit Eventstreams.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez On, tout ce que nous faisons est profondément enraciné dans l'innovation au cœur et plus précisément dans nos produits physiques. C'est pourquoi nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur logiciel du personnel pour l'équipe d'innovation produit dans la grappe de R-D produit avec une solide expérience dans le développement complet, l'infrastructure cloud, et les systèmes événementiel pour aider à construire la prochaine génération de plateformes numériques qui alimentent l'innovation produit à On.

En tant que membre clé de notre équipe d'innovation, vous jouerez un rôle central dans le développement d'expériences numériques innovantes qui se connectent avec notre plateforme de données de base, des technologies perturbatrices comme LightSpray et de futures innovations exploratoires. Vous serez responsable de la conception et de la construction d'applications cloud-native évolutives à partir du sol. En plus d'être pratique, vous encadrerez les membres de l'équipe, partagerez vos connaissances et votre expertise et influencerez l'orientation technique de nos efforts d'innovation.

Vous serez basé à Zurich et êtes prêt à être dans le bureau deux jours par semaine . Vous collaborerez étroitement avec une équipe interfonctionnelle entre Tech et Innovation, tout en servant de personne-ressource pour la vision architecturale de cet espace au sein des équipes de gestion de la technologie et des produits dans les bureaux mondiaux d'On.

Votre mission

• Conduire le développement de plates-formes de pointe et d'applications web interactives, en utilisant des technologies telles que TypeScript, Node.js et React, qui s'intègrent parfaitement à notre architecture de base axée sur les événements (Kafka).

• Concevoir, construire et maintenir une infrastructure cloud évolutive et résistante sur des plateformes comme GCP ou AWS , en veillant à ce que nos produits innovants soient construits sur une base solide.

• Connaissances techniques propres à l'ensemble de la pile et de l'infrastructure, en conservant le contexte architectural tout en fournissant des conseils sur les normes Web modernes, la conception d'API et les modèles axés sur les événements.

• Soyez pratique en écrivant et en possédant un code de qualité de production, des API de GraphQL et des consommateurs en streaming aux front-ends interactifs. Établir une barre haute grâce à des examens réfléchis des relations publiques et améliorer continuellement la fiabilité et l'opérabilité.

• Agir comme un mentor technique pour les ingénieurs sur le développement complet, les principes cloud-native, et les meilleures pratiques pour interagir avec les plateformes de données en streaming comme Kafka.

jobs.title: Senior Lead, People Analytics

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file, Analyse des personnes

jobs.description:
In short:

As the Senior Lead, People Analytics, you will be the architect of our new People Analytics platform and a strategic partner for our global people agenda. Reporting to the Head of People Analytics and as part of the People Analytics team, you will empower the organisation with data-driven insights, build the data pipelines and platform the whole team runs on, push our statistical and predictive modeling further, and champion the next frontier of AI and agentic automation to unlock human potential at On.

Your Mission:

• Own the data engineering backbone of our People Analytics Platform: pipelines, data modeling, and orchestration, so the rest of the team's dashboards and analyses sit on governed, reliable data.

• Build and maintain the semantic/metric layer as the single source of truth, ensuring definitions are consistent across every dashboard and report.

• Support the build-out of our AI and agentic layer: from an internal AI co-pilot to embedding LLM-assisted workflows into the HR team's day-to-day analysis and reporting.

• Partner closely with our data scientist to strengthen our statistical and predictive modeling bench applying regression, clustering, and causal inference techniques to separate correlation from real impact.

• Develop and deliver insightful dashboards, reports, and analyses on the full employee lifecycle and key HR metrics, including headcount, talent acquisition, employee engagement, and attrition.

• Act as a technical subject matter expert for People Analytics, providing guidance and support to HR and business leaders. Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and high-impact analytical projects.

• Ensure Data Governance and integrity across all our HR systems.

• Storytelling & Influence: Develop and deliver compelling, data-driven stories and presentations that effectively communicate insights and recommendations.

Your Story:

• You bring 7+ years of experience in People Analytics or a related data science field, with a deep understanding of HR data and metrics.

• You have strong data engineering skills: building and maintaining pipelines, data models, and a governed semantic layer using tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, One Model, or BigQuery.

• You have strong technical skills in R, Python, SQL, and Excel for data analysis and modeling, plus a modern BI tool (Looker, Power BI, or similar).

• You possess a strong, hands-on understanding of statistical analysis and modeling techniques (regression, clustering) and ideally causal inference methods that go beyond correlation.

• Prior familiarity with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP HR, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and their reporting modules (e.g. Prism,...) is a strong plus, though not a strict requirement.

• You are genuinely energized by AI: comfortable or willing to learn building agentic workflows and AI-assisted tooling, not just prompting for one-off answers.

• You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear and actionable insights.

Your Team:

You'll join a small, high-caliber People Analytics team at On. You'll build and maintain the platform the team's Data Science and HRIS expertise runs on. You won't be receiving a playbook, you'll be helping write it, so an entrepreneurial spirit is key. Working closely with world-class HR leadership and business stakeholders to build a cutting-edge analytics capability.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve:

Come Senior Lead, People Analytics, sarai l'architetto della nostra nuova piattaforma People Analytics e un partner strategico per la nostra agenda globale. Segnalando al capo di People Analytics e nell'ambito del team di People Analytics, autorizzerai l'organizzazione con approfondimenti basati sui dati, costruirai le pipeline di dati e la piattaforma su cui l'intero team corre, spingi ulteriormente la nostra modellazione statistica e predittiva e campioni la prossima frontiera dell'IA e dell'automazione agentica per sbloccare il potenziale umano a On.

La vostra missione:

• Possedere la spina dorsale dell'ingegneria dei dati della nostra piattaforma People Analytics: pipeline, modellazione dei dati e orchestrazione, così il resto delle dashboard e delle analisi del team siedono su dati regolati e affidabili.

• Costruire e mantenere lo strato semantico / metrico come unica fonte di verità, assicurando le definizioni sono coerenti in ogni cruscotto e rapporto.

• Sostenere l'accumulo del nostro livello AI e agentic: da un co-pilota AI interno a incorporare flussi di lavoro assistiti da LLM nell'analisi e nella segnalazione quotidiana del team HR.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con il nostro scienziato di dati per rafforzare la nostra panca di modellazione statistica e predittiva applicando le tecniche di regressione, clustering e inferenza causale per separare la correlazione da impatto reale.

• Sviluppare e fornire dashboard, report e analisi approfondite sul ciclo di vita completo dei dipendenti e le metriche chiave delle risorse umane, tra cui headcount, acquisizione di talenti, coinvolgimento dei dipendenti e attrito.

• Agire come esperto di materia tecnica per People Analytics, fornendo guida e supporto alle risorse umane e ai leader aziendali. Collabora con gli stakeholder per tradurre i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni tecniche e progetti analitici ad alto impatto.

• Assicurare la governance e l'integrità dei dati in tutti i nostri sistemi HR.

• Storytelling & Influence: Sviluppare e fornire storie e presentazioni accattivanti e orientate ai dati che comunicano efficacemente intuizioni e raccomandazioni.

La tua storia:

• Porti 7+ anni di esperienza in People Analytics o in un campo relativo alla scienza dei dati, con una profonda comprensione dei dati e delle metriche delle risorse umane.

• Hai forti capacità di ingegneria dei dati: costruzione e mantenimento di tubazioni, modelli di dati e uno strato semantico governato utilizzando strumenti come Snowflake, Databricks, One Model, o BigQuery.

• Hai forti competenze tecniche in R, Python, SQL e Excel per l'analisi e la modellazione dei dati, oltre a un moderno strumento BI (Looker, Power BI, o simili).

• Possiedi una forte comprensione pratica dell'analisi statistica e delle tecniche di modellazione (regressione, raggruppamento) e metodi idealmente di inferenza causale che vanno oltre la correlazione.

• La prima familiarità con le piattaforme HRIS (ad esempio, Workday, SAP HR, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) e i loro moduli di reporting (ad esempio Prism,...) è un vantaggio forte, anche se non un requisito rigoroso.

• Sei veramente eccitato da AI: comodo o disposto ad imparare i flussi di lavoro agentici di costruzione e gli strumenti assistiti da AI, non solo richiedendo risposte one-off.

• Hai eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di tradurre dati complessi in insight chiari e attuabili.

Il vostro team:

Ti unirai a un team di People Analytics di piccole dimensioni. Costruirai e manterrai la piattaforma su cui si basa l'esperienza Data Science e HRIS del team. Non riceverai un playbook, ti aiuterai a scriverlo, quindi uno spirito imprenditoriale è fondamentale. Lavorare a stretto contatto con la leadership HR di livello mondiale e gli stakeholder aziendali per costruire una capacità di analisi all'avanguardia.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurzum:

Als Senior Lead, People Analytics, werden Sie der Architekt unserer neuen People Analytics-Plattform und ein strategischer Partner für unsere globale Mitarbeiteragenda sein. Berichterstattung an den Head of People Analytics und als Teil des People Analytics-Teams werden Sie das Unternehmen mit datengesteuerten Erkenntnissen befähigen, die Datenpipelines und die Plattform aufbauen, auf der das gesamte Team läuft, unsere statistische und prädiktive Modellierung weiter vorantreiben und sich für die nächste Grenze der KI und Agentenautomatisierung einsetzen, um menschliches Potenzial bei On freizusetzen.

Ihre Mission:

• Besitzen Sie das Data Engineering-Backbone unserer People Analytics-Plattform: Pipelines, Datenmodellierung und Orchestrierung, so dass der Rest der Dashboards und Analysen des Teams auf verwalteten, zuverlässigen Daten basiert.

• Erstellen und pflegen Sie die semantische / metrische Schicht als einzige Quelle der Wahrheit, um sicherzustellen, dass die Definitionen in jedem Dashboard und Bericht konsistent sind.

• Unterstützen Sie den Aufbau unserer KI- und Agentenschicht: von einem internen KI-Copiloten bis hin zur Einbettung von LLM-gestützten Workflows in die tägliche Analyse und Berichterstattung des HR-Teams.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Data Scientist, um unsere statistische und prädiktive Modellierungsbank mit Regressions-, Clustering- und Kausalinferenztechniken zu stärken, um die Korrelation von den realen Auswirkungen zu trennen.

• Entwickeln und liefern Sie aufschlussreiche Dashboards, Berichte und Analysen zum gesamten Mitarbeiterlebenszyklus und zu wichtigen HR-Metriken, einschließlich Mitarbeiterzahl, Talentakquisition, Mitarbeiterbindung und Abnutzung.

• Handeln Sie als technischer Fachexperte für People Analytics und bieten Sie HR- und Unternehmensleitern Beratung und Unterstützung. Arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern zusammen, um Geschäftsanforderungen in technische Lösungen und wirkungsvolle analytische Projekte umzusetzen.

• Sicherstellen von Data Governance und Integrität in allen unseren HR-Systemen.

• Storytelling & Influence: Entwickeln und liefern Sie überzeugende, datengesteuerte Geschichten und Präsentationen, die Erkenntnisse und Empfehlungen effektiv vermitteln.

Deine Geschichte:

• Sie bringen mehr als 7 Jahre Erfahrung in People Analytics oder einem verwandten Data Science-Bereich mit, mit einem tiefen Verständnis von HR-Daten und Metriken.

• Sie verfügen über fundierte Data-Engineering-Fähigkeiten: Aufbau und Wartung von Pipelines, Datenmodellen und einer verwalteten semantischen Ebene mit Tools wie Snowflake, Databricks, One Model oder BigQuery.

• Sie verfügen über fundierte technische Kenntnisse in R, Python, SQL und Excel für die Datenanalyse und -modellierung sowie über ein modernes BI-Tool (Looker, Power BI oder ähnliches).

• Sie besitzen ein starkes, praktisches Verständnis der statistischen Analyse und Modellierungstechniken (Regression, Clustering) und idealerweise kausale Inferenzmethoden, die über die Korrelation hinausgehen.

• Die vorherige Vertrautheit mit HRIS-Plattformen (z. B. Workday, SAP HR, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) und ihren Berichtsmodulen (z. B. Prism, ...) ist ein starkes Plus, wenn auch keine strenge Anforderung.

• Sie werden von AI wirklich mit Energie versorgt: bequem oder bereit, den Aufbau agentischer Workflows und KI-gestützter Tools zu lernen, nicht nur für einmalige Antworten.

• Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten und können komplexe Daten in klare und umsetzbare Erkenntnisse übersetzen.

Ihr Team:

Sie werden einem kleinen, hochkarätigen People Analytics-Team bei On beitreten. Sie bauen und pflegen die Plattform, auf der das Data Science- und HRIS-Know-how des Teams läuft. Sie werden kein Spielbuch erhalten, Sie werden helfen, es zu schreiben, also ist ein Unternehmergeist der Schlüssel. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erstklassigen HR-Führungskräften und Geschäftsinteressenvertretern, um eine hochmoderne Analysefähigkeit aufzubauen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref:

En tant que responsable principal, People Analytics, vous serez l'architecte de notre nouvelle plateforme People Analytics et un partenaire stratégique pour notre agenda mondial des personnes. Relevant du responsable de People Analytics et dans le cadre de l'équipe de People Analytics, vous donnerez à l'organisation des informations basées sur les données, créerez les pipelines de données et la plate-forme sur laquelle l'ensemble de l'équipe fonctionne, pousserez davantage notre modélisation statistique et prédictive, et défendrez la prochaine frontière de l'IA et de l'automatisation des agents pour libérer le potentiel humain chez On.

Votre mission :

• Posséder l'épine dorsale de l'ingénierie des données de notre plateforme People Analytics : pipelines, modélisation de données et orchestration, de sorte que le reste des tableaux de bord et analyses de l'équipe s'assoient sur des données contrôlées et fiables.

• Construire et maintenir la couche sémantique/métrique comme source unique de vérité, en veillant à ce que les définitions soient cohérentes dans chaque tableau de bord et rapport.

• Soutenir la mise en place de notre couche d'IA et d'agents : d'un copilote interne d'IA à l'intégration des workflows assistés par LLM dans l'analyse quotidienne et les rapports de l'équipe RH.

• Collaborez étroitement avec notre spécialiste des données pour renforcer notre banc de modélisation statistique et prédictive en appliquant des techniques de régression, de regroupement et d'inférence causale pour séparer la corrélation de l'impact réel.

• Élaborer et fournir des tableaux de bord, des rapports et des analyses éclairés sur le cycle de vie complet des employés et les principales mesures des RH, y compris le dénombrement, l'acquisition de talents, l'engagement des employés et l'attrition.

• Agir en tant qu'expert technique pour l'analyse des personnes, en fournissant des conseils et un soutien aux RH et aux chefs d'entreprise. Collaborer avec les intervenants pour traduire les exigences opérationnelles en solutions techniques et en projets d'analyse à impact élevé.

• Assurer la gouvernance et l'intégrité des données dans tous nos systèmes de RH.

• Storytelling & Influence: Concevoir et fournir des histoires et des présentations convaincantes et axées sur les données qui communiquent efficacement des idées et des recommandations.

Votre histoire :

• Vous apportez 7+ ans d'expérience dans l'analyse des personnes ou un domaine connexe de la science des données, avec une compréhension profonde des données et des paramètres RH.

• Vous avez de solides compétences en ingénierie des données : construire et maintenir des pipelines, des modèles de données et une couche sémantique gouvernée à l'aide d'outils tels que Snowflake, Databricks, One Model ou BigQuery.

• Vous avez de solides compétences techniques en R, Python, SQL et Excel pour l'analyse de données et la modélisation, ainsi qu'un outil BI moderne (Looker, Power BI, ou similaire).

• Vous possédez une solide compréhension pratique des techniques d'analyse statistique et de modélisation (régression, regroupement) et idéalement des méthodes d'inférence causale qui vont au-delà de la corrélation.

• La connaissance préalable des plates-formes HRIS (p. ex. Workday, SAP HR, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) et de leurs modules de rapport (p. ex. Prism,...) est un plus fort, mais pas une exigence stricte.

• Vous êtes vraiment sous l'impulsion de l'IA : confortable ou prêt à apprendre à construire des workflows d'agents et des outils assistés par l'IA, pas seulement pour obtenir des réponses ponctuelles.

• Vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des intervenants, avec la capacité de traduire des données complexes en idées claires et exploitables.

Votre équipe :

Vous rejoindrez une petite équipe de People Analytics de haut calibre à On. Vous allez construire et maintenir la plate-forme sur laquelle s'appuie l'expertise Data Science et HRIS de l'équipe. Vous ne recevrez pas de playbook, vous aiderez à l'écrire, donc un esprit d'entreprise est la clé. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants des RH et les intervenants commerciaux de calibre mondial pour créer une capacité d'analyse de pointe.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Pattern Engineer
jobs.description:
In short:

We are seeking an internationally seasoned, highly specialized Senior Lead - Pattern Engineer to spearhead the technical lifecycle of our global product lines from concept to production. This strategic leadership role requires an elite mastery of both digital and manual pattern architecture, combined with a proven track record of managing garment engineers while working closely with Design, Technical Design, and suppliers.

The successful candidate will directly lead, manage, and scale our internal team of pattern engineers. This position acts as the definitive global technical authority for pattern engineering - architecting scalable fitting systems, optimizing cross-functional 2D/3D workflows, and driving the professional growth of their direct reports to reduce development timelines and ensure flawless global fit consistency.

Your Mission:

• Lead, manage, and evaluate a dedicated internal team of Pattern Engineers.

• Design and execute internal training on advanced fitting techniques, complex pattern adjustments, and Gerber Accumark instruction.

• Manage team workflow distribution and capacity against dynamic seasonal product creation calendars.

• Establish global pattern standards and technical production standards relative to fit and quality benchmarks.

• Spearhead high-profile franchise updates and complex special projects, translating technical sketches into scalable, production-ready patterns.

• Implement and maintain robust systems for fitting processes, digital pattern management, and PLM pipelines to improve sample approval rates.

• Lead high-level fit sessions on live models, acting as the ultimate cross-functional expert between Design, Sourcing, and Materials.

• Drive the integration of 2D digital pattern making with 3D prototyping software (CLO/Browzwear) to optimize fabric efficiency.

Your Story:

• A minimum of 10–12+ years of progressive experience in pattern engineering and technical apparel design within premier global brands.international vendor communication. Knowledge of a Swiss national language (German, French, or Italian) is considered a strong asset.

• A degree in Apparel Design, Pattern Engineering, or a related field. Prior experience acting as an industry instructor or academic specialist in CAD/Pattern software is highly preferred.

• Proven track record of direct people management and supervisory experience, having previously led a team of pattern engineers, patternmakers, or technical designers in a brand environment.

• Expert-level proficiency in industry-leading CAD systems (specifically Gerber Accumark Explorer/Design & Marker Making or Lectra), PLM software, and Adobe Illustrator. High proficiency in 3D apparel simulation tools (CLO 3D or Browzwear) is required.

• Deep expertise in the unique physical properties of technical, performance, stretch-woven, and multi-category fabrics (including experience in complex categories like performance bottoms and custom structured garments).

• Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills with a proven track record of driving process improvements, managing team performance, and presenting technical solutions to senior leadership.

• Full professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required as the primary language for global cross-functional collaboration and

Your Team:

In this role, you will collaborate with the Development, Design, Materials, Sourcing, suppliers, and Product Management teams to translate the product design intent and style vision into a consistent fit, quality, and execution level by leading the team responsible for our product’s technical specifications on fit, sizing, and commercialization requirements.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve:

Siamo alla ricerca di un leader senior altamente specializzato a livello internazionale - Pattern Engineer per testare il ciclo di vita tecnico delle nostre linee di prodotto globali dal concetto alla produzione. Questo ruolo di leadership strategica richiede una padronanza d'élite sia dell'architettura digitale che manuale del modello, unitamente a un comprovato record di traccia di gestione degli ingegneri del capo mentre si lavora a stretto contatto con Design, Design Tecnico e fornitori.

Il candidato di successo porterà direttamente, gestire e scalare il nostro team interno di ingegneri di pattern. Questa posizione agisce come l'autorità tecnica globale definitiva per l'ingegneria dei modelli - l'archiviazione di sistemi di montaggio scalabili, l'ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro 2D/3D interfunzionali e la crescita professionale dei loro rapporti diretti per ridurre i tempi di sviluppo e garantire una perfetta consistenza globale.

La vostra missione:

• Guidare, gestire e valutare un team interno dedicato di Pattern Engineers.

• Progettare ed eseguire la formazione interna su tecniche di montaggio avanzate, regolazioni complesse del modello e istruzioni Gerber Accumark.

• Gestisci la distribuzione del flusso di lavoro del team e la capacità contro i calendari di creazione dinamica dei prodotti stagionali.

• Stabilire standard di pattern globali e standard di produzione tecnica relativi a parametri di misura e qualità.

• Aggiornamenti di franchising di alto profilo e progetti speciali complessi, traducendo schizzi tecnici in modelli scalabili e pronti alla produzione.

• Implementare e mantenere sistemi robusti per i processi di montaggio, la gestione dei modelli digitali e le tubazioni PLM per migliorare i tassi di approvazione del campione.

• Condurre sessioni di vestibilità di alto livello su modelli dal vivo, agendo come l'ultimo esperto interfunzionale tra Design, Sourcing e Materiali.

• Guidare l'integrazione di modelli digitali 2D con software di prototipazione 3D (CLO/Browzwear) per ottimizzare l'efficienza del tessuto.

La tua storia:

• Un minimo di 10–12+ anni di esperienza progressiva nell'ingegneria del modello e nel design dell'abbigliamento tecnico all'interno di marchi leader globali. comunicazione di fornitori internazionali. La conoscenza di una lingua nazionale svizzera (tedesco, francese o italiano) è considerata un bene forte.

• Una laurea in Apparel Design, Pattern Engineering, o un campo correlato. L'esperienza precedente che funge da istruttore di settore o specialista accademico nel software CAD/Pattern è molto preferita.

• Provato record di gestione delle persone dirette e esperienza di supervisione, avendo precedentemente guidato un team di ingegneri di pattern, modellisti, o progettisti tecnici in un ambiente di marca.

• La competenza a livello di esperti nei sistemi CAD leader del settore (in particolare Gerber Accumark Explorer/Design & Marker Making o Lectra), software PLM e Adobe Illustrator. È necessaria un'elevata competenza negli strumenti di simulazione dell'abbigliamento 3D (CLO 3D o Browzwear).

• Profonda competenza nelle proprietà fisiche uniche di tessuti tecnici, performanti, tessuti elasticizzati e multi-categoria (compresa l'esperienza in categorie complesse come i fondali delle prestazioni e i capi strutturati personalizzati).

• Competenze di leadership interfunzionali eccezionali con un comprovato record di miglioramento del processo di guida, gestione delle prestazioni del team, e presentando soluzioni tecniche alla leadership senior.

• La piena fluidità professionale in inglese (scritto e parlato) è richiesta come lingua primaria per la collaborazione interfunzionale globale e

Il vostro team:

In questo ruolo, collaborerai con i team Development, Design, Materials, Sourcing, Fornitori e Product Management per tradurre l’intento di progettazione del prodotto e la visione di stile in un livello coerente di vestibilità, qualità e esecuzione, portando il team responsabile delle specifiche tecniche del nostro prodotto su misura, dimensionamento e requisiti di commercializzazione.

jobs.description:
In short:

On is looking for a pragmatic, business-minded lawyer to join our Intellectual Property Team as Senior Lead, Intellectual Property & Brand Protection Counsel. In this role, you will play a critical role in proactively protecting On’s trademarks, designs, and innovations. You will thrive here if you can independently manage complex matters, anticipate issues before they escalate, and provide clear, practical advice in a fast-moving global business.

Your Mission:

• Advise global and regional teams on a broad range of intellectual property matters, including brand protection, anticounterfeiting, and enforcement.

• Lead global brand protection and anti-counterfeiting investigations and actions efficiently and aligned with business objectives.

• Develop and implement enforcement strategies.

• Partner with cross-functional teams and build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholder groups, conduct trainings and raise IP awareness.

• Build scalable processes, playbooks, and guidelines and drive practical solutions that reflect both global priorities and regional requirements.

• Support strategic IP projects as needed.

Your Story:

• Law degree and 7+ years of legal experience, including in-house experience.

• Experience at a global consumer-facing brand is preferred.

• Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to balance legal risk and business objectives.

• Excellent negotiation, communication (Fluent English) and analytical skills.

• Ability to provide clear, practical advice in high-pressure, fast-moving environments.

• Collaborative style and strong relationship-building skills across diverse teams and stakeholders.

• Process-minded and curious, with a track record of improving how legal work gets done.

• Comfortable operating independently, prioritizing effectively and working across unfamiliar legal or business issues.

Your Team:

Being part of the On Legal Team means working as an entrepreneurial, solutions-oriented partner to the business. We move quickly, think commercially, and work closely across regions and functions to help On grow responsibly. You will have autonomy, visibility, and the opportunity to shape intellectual property at On.

jobs.title: Senior Lead - Last Engineer
jobs.description:
In Short

At On, the secret to our signature cloud-like sensation starts from the inside out. The last is the very foundation of our footwear, dictating fit, performance, and aesthetic. We are seeking a visionary Senior Lead Last Engineer to pioneer the creation, optimization, and management of our footwear lasts across all product categories.

In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between biomechanics, design, and manufacturing. You will serve as the central authority on all last-related topics, ensuring our performance running, fashion, and lifestyle shoes deliver the ultimate fit and experience for our global community.

Key Responsibilities

• Standardization & Consolidation: Establish clear standards and best practices for all new last creations. Champion the implementation of these guidelines across internal teams and suppliers to strategically consolidate and optimize our existing last library.

• Last Creation & Internal Consulting: Lead the hands-on creation of new lasts while acting as the primary technical consultant for Design, Development, and Innovation teams regarding last grading, selection, and fit optimization for new and existing projects.

• Supplier Relationship Management: Build and manage strong, collaborative relationships with external last suppliers and manufacturers to ensure quality, precision, and timely delivery.

• Library Management: Own and meticulously maintain our comprehensive digital and physical last libraries, ensuring all data is accurate, organized, and easily accessible to cross-functional teams.

• Sourcing & Production Support: Partner with the Sourcing and Manufacturing teams to resolve technical last challenges, streamline production processes, and provide expert guidance on last-related topics at the factory level.

• Process Innovation: Continuously evaluate and improve our last development workflows, integrating the latest 3D modeling technologies and fit-data insights.

Requirements

• Comprehensive Last Modeling Expertise: 8 years+ hands-on experience in last engineering across both high-performance running and fashion/lifestyle footwear. You must possess a deep understanding of dynamic fit, foot anatomy, and biomechanics, while also knowing how to balance complex aesthetic requirements with commercial fit standards.

• Program & Library Management: Proven experience managing comprehensive last development programs for a sports or performance footwear brand. Must possess exceptional organizational skills to build, consolidate, and seamlessly manage extensive digital and physical last libraries while juggling multiple development calendars from concept to mass production.

• Manufacturing Equipment Operation: Practical ability to utilize physical last manufacturing and digitizing equipment, specifically 3D scanners and milling machines, to create, reverse-engineer, and modify physical models.

• Technical & CAD Proficiency: Advanced skills in 3D CAD software relevant to last design and modification (e.g., Romans CAD, Rhino, or similar footwear-specific engineering tools).

• Industry Knowledge: Extensive understanding of footwear manufacturing processes, tooling, and grading principles.

• Project Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage extensive digital and physical libraries and juggle multiple development calendars simultaneously.

• Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and external suppliers.

About the Team

The Footwear Engineering team is a highly specialized collective of Pattern Engineers, Tooling Engineers, and Last Engineers who hold the keys to the ultimate fit, feel, and ride of every On shoe. Rooted in our proud heritage of meticulous Swiss engineering, we obsess over every millimeter and material to craft the absolute best performance products for elite athletes and everyday consumers alike. We are the critical bridge between radical design and physical reality, working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment where data-driven precision fuels our relentless dedication to human movement.

Devi possedere una profonda comprensione della vestibilità dinamica, dell'anatomia del piede e della biomeccanica, pur sapendo come bilanciare esigenze estetiche complesse con standard di vestibilità commerciale.

- Program & Library Management: esperienza di Proven che gestisce programmi completi di sviluppo di ultimi programmi per un marchio di calzature sportive o performanti. Deve possedere eccezionali capacità organizzative per costruire, consolidare e gestire senza soluzione di continuità ampie librerie digitali e fisiche, mentre si destreggiano più calendari di sviluppo dalla produzione di concept alla produzione di massa.

- Funzionamento delle apparecchiature di produzione: Capacità pratica di utilizzare apparecchiature fisiche di ultima fabbricazione e digitalizzazione, in particolare 3D scanners e fresatrici, per creare, invertire-ingegneri, e modificare modelli fisici.

- Project Management: Forte capacità organizzative con la capacità di gestire ampie librerie digitali e fisiche e di destreggiare più calendari di sviluppo contemporaneamente.

- Capacità di comunicazione: Ottime capacità interpersonali e comunicative per tradurre efficacemente concetti tecnici complessi a soggetti non tecnici e fornitori esterni.

Riguardo la squadra

Il team di Footwear Engineering è un collettivo altamente specializzato di ingegneri Pattern, Tooling Engineers e Last Engineers che tengono le chiavi per la vestibilità, il tatto e la ride di ogni scarpa On. Radicato nel nostro orgoglioso patrimonio di meticolosa ingegneria svizzera, ossessionato da ogni millimetro e materiale per realizzare i prodotti migliori prestazioni assoluti per atleti d'elite e consumatori quotidiani.

Siamo il ponte critico tra design radicale e realtà fisica, lavorando in un ambiente veloce e collaborativo dove la precisione basata sui dati alimenta la nostra instancabile dedizione al movimento umano.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In Short

At On, the secret to our signature cloud-like sensation starts from the inside out. The last is the very foundation of our footwear, dictating fit, performance, and aesthetic. We are seeking a visionary Senior Lead Last Engineer to pioneer the creation, optimization, and management of our footwear lasts across all product categories.

In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between biomechanics, design, and manufacturing. You will serve as the central authority on all last-related topics, ensuring our performance running, fashion, and lifestyle shoes deliver the ultimate fit and experience for our global community.

Key Responsibilities

• Standardization & Consolidation: Establish clear standards and best practices for all new last creations. Champion the implementation of these guidelines across internal teams and suppliers to strategically consolidate and optimize our existing last library.

• Last Creation & Internal Consulting: Lead the hands-on creation of new lasts while acting as the primary technical consultant for Design, Development, and Innovation teams regarding last grading, selection, and fit optimization for new and existing projects.

• Supplier Relationship Management: Build and manage strong, collaborative relationships with external last suppliers and manufacturers to ensure quality, precision, and timely delivery.

• Library Management: Own and meticulously maintain our comprehensive digital and physical last libraries, ensuring all data is accurate, organized, and easily accessible to cross-functional teams.

• Sourcing & Production Support: Partner with the Sourcing and Manufacturing teams to resolve technical last challenges, streamline production processes, and provide expert guidance on last-related topics at the factory level.

• Process Innovation: Continuously evaluate and improve our last development workflows, integrating the latest 3D modeling technologies and fit-data insights.

Requirements

• Comprehensive Last Modeling Expertise: 8 years+ hands-on experience in last engineering across both high-performance running and fashion/lifestyle footwear. You must possess a deep understanding of dynamic fit, foot anatomy, and biomechanics, while also knowing how to balance complex aesthetic requirements with commercial fit standards.

• Program & Library Management: Proven experience managing comprehensive last development programs for a sports or performance footwear brand. Must possess exceptional organizational skills to build, consolidate, and seamlessly manage extensive digital and physical last libraries while juggling multiple development calendars from concept to mass production.

• Manufacturing Equipment Operation: Practical ability to utilize physical last manufacturing and digitizing equipment, specifically 3D scanners and milling machines, to create, reverse-engineer, and modify physical models.

• Technical & CAD Proficiency: Advanced skills in 3D CAD software relevant to last design and modification (e.g., Romans CAD, Rhino, or similar footwear-specific engineering tools).

• Industry Knowledge: Extensive understanding of footwear manufacturing processes, tooling, and grading principles.

• Project Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage extensive digital and physical libraries and juggle multiple development calendars simultaneously.

• Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and external suppliers.

About the Team

The Footwear Engineering team is a highly specialized collective of Pattern Engineers, Tooling Engineers, and Last Engineers who hold the keys to the ultimate fit, feel, and ride of every On shoe. Rooted in our proud heritage of meticulous Swiss engineering, we obsess over every millimeter and material to craft the absolute best performance products for elite athletes and everyday consumers alike. We are the critical bridge between radical design and physical reality, working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment where data-driven precision fuels our relentless dedication to human movement.

Warenbezeichnung

Kurz gefasst

Bei On beginnt das Geheimnis unserer charakteristischen cloudartigen Empfindung von innen nach außen. Das letzte ist die Grundlage unserer Schuhe, Diktat, Passform, Leistung und Ästhetik. Wir suchen einen visionären Senior Lead Last Engineer, der die Erstellung, Optimierung und Verwaltung unserer Schuhe in allen Produktkategorien voranstellt.

In dieser zentralen Rolle überbrücken Sie die Lücke zwischen Biomechanik, Design und Fertigung. Sie dienen als zentrale Autorität für alle letzten Themen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Performance-, Mode- und Lifestyle-Schuhe die ultimative Passform und Erfahrung für unsere globale Gemeinschaft liefern.

- Standardisierung & Konsolidierung: Stellen Sie klare Standards und Best Practices für alle neuen letzten Kreationen fest. Championieren Sie die Umsetzung dieser Richtlinien über interne Teams und Lieferanten hinweg, um unsere bestehende letzte Bibliothek strategisch zu konsolidieren und zu optimieren.

Wir sind die kritische Brücke zwischen radikalem Design und physischer Realität, die in einem schnelllebigen, hochkooperativen Umfeld arbeitet, in dem datengetriebene Präzision unser unermüdliches Engagement für die menschliche Bewegung fördert.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

En bref

Le secret de notre impression de nuage signature commence de l'intérieur. Le dernier est le fondement même de nos chaussures, dictant la forme, la performance et l'esthétique. Nous recherchons un chef de file principal visionnaire pour faire la première place à la création, l'optimisation et la gestion de nos chaussures pour toutes les catégories de produits.

Dans ce rôle central, vous comblerez l'écart entre la biomécanique, le design et la fabrication. Vous serez l'autorité centrale sur tous les derniers sujets liés, assurant nos performances, la mode et les chaussures de style de vie offrent l'ajustement et l'expérience ultimes pour notre communauté mondiale.

Principales responsabilités

- Normalisation et consolidation : Établir des normes et des pratiques exemplaires claires pour toutes les nouvelles créations. Faire la promotion de la mise en oeuvre de ces lignes directrices auprès des équipes internes et des fournisseurs afin de consolider et d'optimiser stratégiquement notre dernière bibliothèque existante.

- Dernière Création & Conseil Interne : Dirigez la création pratique de nouvelles dures tout en agissant comme consultant technique principal pour les équipes de Design, Développement et Innovation concernant le dernier classement, sélection et optimisation de l'ajustement pour les projets nouveaux et existants.

- Gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs : Établir et gérer des relations solides et collaboratives avec les derniers fournisseurs et fabricants externes pour assurer la qualité, la précision et la livraison en temps opportun.

- Gestion de la bibliothèque : Préservez et maintenez méticuleusement nos dernières bibliothèques numériques et physiques complètes, en veillant à ce que toutes les données soient exactes, organisées et facilement accessibles aux équipes interfonctionnelles.

- Sourcing & Support de production : Partenaire avec les équipes Sourcing and Manufacturing pour résoudre les derniers défis techniques, rationaliser les processus de production et fournir des conseils d'experts sur les derniers sujets liés au niveau de l'usine.

- Innovation en processus : Évaluer et améliorer en permanence nos derniers flux de développement, en intégrant les dernières technologies de modélisation 3D et les informations sur l'ajustement des données.

Besoins

- Expertise complète de la dernière modélisation : 8 ans d'expérience pratique en dernière ingénierie sur les chaussures de course et de mode/style de vie. Vous devez posséder une compréhension profonde de la forme dynamique, de l'anatomie des pieds et de la biomécanique, tout en sachant aussi équilibrer les exigences esthétiques complexes avec les normes commerciales d'ajustement.

- Gestion de programmes et de bibliothèques : Expérience de gestion de programmes de développement complets pour une marque de chaussures de sport ou de performance. Doit posséder des compétences organisationnelles exceptionnelles pour construire, consolider et gérer sans heurts des bibliothèques numériques et physiques complètes et jongler avec plusieurs calendriers de développement, du concept à la production de masse.

- Utilisation de matériel de fabrication : Capacité pratique d'utiliser les derniers équipements de fabrication et de numérisation, en particulier les scanners 3D et les fraiseuses, pour créer, inverser et modifier des modèles physiques.

- Compétences techniques et CAO : Compétences avancées en logiciels CAO 3D pertinents pour la dernière conception et modification (p. ex., CAO romain, Rhino ou outils d'ingénierie similaires).

- Connaissances de l'industrie : Compréhension approfondie des processus de fabrication de chaussures, des outils et des principes de classement.

- Gestion de projet : Fortes compétences organisationnelles avec la capacité de gérer simultanément des bibliothèques numériques et physiques et de jongler avec plusieurs calendriers de développement.

- Compétences en communication: Excellentes aptitudes en relations interpersonnelles et en communication pour traduire efficacement des concepts techniques complexes à des acteurs non techniques et à des fournisseurs externes.

À propos de l'équipe

L'équipe de la société Footwear Engineering est un collectif hautement spécialisé de Pattern Engineers, Tooling Engineers et Last Engineers qui détiennent les clés de l'ajustement, de la sensation et du roulement ultimes de chaque chaussure On.

Nous sommes le pont essentiel entre la conception radicale et la réalité physique, travaillant dans un environnement de collaboration rapide et très collaboratif où la précision basée sur les données alimente notre dévouement inlassable au mouvement humain.

jobs.description:
In short
 Reporting to the Global Head of Integrated Business Planning (IBP), the Senior Global IBP Lead & Process Owner is responsible for the governance, optimization, and seamless execution of our end-to-end global planning cycle. In this role, you will ensure process discipline and timeline accountability across all functions, while concurrently partnering with the Global Head of IBP to support strategic content development. Serving as a key global sparring partner to regional IBP leads, you will help bridge regional commercial dynamics with global strategy, transforming operational analytics into a structured business context that facilitates executive decision-making.

Your mission
 - Own and manage the comprehensive global IBP meeting cadence, timeline milestones, and data-readiness protocols across all global and regional hubs.
- Drive operational discipline across cross-functional teams by rigorously tracking cycle deliverables, managing action-item registries, and ensuring timely, high-quality data inputs.
- Continuously evaluate and refine the IBP framework, identifying procedural bottlenecks, streamlining workflows, and implementing best-in-class planning methodologies.
- Partner with various On teams to generate complex analytics translating commercial, financial and operational data sets into actionable insights with clear decision-driving outcomes.
- Collaborate closely with the Global Head of IBP to synthesize complex analytics and market signals into cohesive, executive-level business narratives and scenario options.
- Provide strategic support to regional IBP leads, acting as a sounding board to ensure regional insights, commercial risks, and supply-demand dynamics are effectively calibrated for global alignment.
- Contribute to the curation of purposeful agendas for regional & global IBP decision forums, ensuring that meetings are structured to address critical strategic trade-offs and result in actionable outcomes.

Your story
 - 10+ years of progressive experience in Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), or strategic commercial planning within a matrixed, high-growth global environment.
- Exceptional organizational and project management capabilities, with a proven track record of executing complex, multi-stakeholder operational cycles with high precision.
- Proven ability to build both recurring and ad hoc analysis and reporting delivered on a regular cadence to leader to raise business insight and drive decision making
- A strong understanding of commercial levers and operational mechanics, allowing you to look beyond data aggregation to comprehend the business drivers behind the numbers.
- Demonstrated talent for distilling large data sets and regional market signals into clear, structured, and actionable business insights.
- Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to constructively drive accountability and foster collaboration with senior stakeholders and across diverse, cross-functional teams.
- Fluency in English is required; command of additional languages is an asset.

Meet the team
 The Integrated Planning team are the strategic integrators of On. We partner across the company to orchestrate end-to-end planning and analytics across the entire product lifecycle. Combining financial data with product, commercial and supply chain data we provide visibility and analytics for decision making to power scalable growth at On. We deliver innovation in how we work, and excellence in all that we do.

We specialize in accurate planning, analysis and clear and simple reporting to drive impactful actions. We act as the bridge between On’s planning teams - gathering and understanding all perspectives, and ensure that accountability and accuracy is at the forefront of how we plan.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.
