jobs.description:
Lead Project Manager - Brand & Product Assets
 Global Marketing Program Management Team

Location: Zurich, Berlin, London (preferred)

In Short
 Born in the Swiss Alps with the goal of revolutionizing the sportswear industry, On has become the world’s fastest-growing premium sportswear brand.
We’re on a mission to ignite the human spirit through movement, staying true to our deep roots in performance running while growing our relevance with those who move in other ways.
To support this ambition, we are looking for a strong project manager with agency experience to drive our Product & Digital Copy projects.
This role will report to the Head of Marketing Program Management – Brand & Product Assets.

The role oversees and coordinates copy development across a wide range of consumer and commercial touchpoints, including CRM emails, product description pages (PDPs), B2B sell-in tools for partners, and retail marketing assets such as footwear wall copy. It also includes product and style naming, development of new terminology (evergreen), and copy for hangtags, packaging, and brand guidelines across all verticals and Special Projects.

This role ensures copy is strategically aligned, delivered on time, and consistently expresses the brand voice across all channels and markets.

If you have experience managing copy processes, understand what makes a strong creative brief, and have a genuine passion for language, this could be the right opportunity to make your mark.

We particularly welcome candidates with diverse life and professional experiences, perspectives, and working styles.

Your Mission

• Own and drive end-to-end project management for all product and digital copy projects, ensuring briefs are complete and aligned through proactive cross-functional validation, copy outputs accurately reflect the brief, and both master English copy and translations are delivered on time.

• Collaborate with the Creative Ops team to allocate copywriters and proactively manage their workload by tracking timelines and prioritization.

• Support the Head of Marketing Program Management – Brand & Product Assets to define and continuously improve processes and ways of working.

• Foster strong alignment across the wider Marketing Program Management team to ensure consistency across all consumer touchpoints.

• Monitor efficiency and key performance metrics, leveraging data-driven insights to continuously optimize and refine approaches for maximum impact.

• Proactively identify and address potential challenges or roadblocks, demonstrating agility and resourcefulness in developing solutions that maintain momentum and deliver strong outcomes.

Your Story

• A minimum of 5-7 years of experience in Project Management within a creative advertising agency is required for this role.

• You have the tenacity to solve hard problems, exceptional initiative, attention to detail and follow-through skills – all with sight of the bigger picture.

• Proven track record in successfully coordinating multiple projects simultaneously from start to finish.

• Strong understanding of product and digital copy processes across CRM emails, product description pages (PDPs), B2B sell-in tools for partners, and retail marketing assets, as well as product and style naming, the development of evergreen terminology, and copy for hangtags, packaging, and brand guidelines across all verticals and special projects.

• Excellent problem-solving, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

• Ability to meet tight timelines, prioritize tasks, and find solutions without compromising quality or positivity.

• Exceptional initiative, attention to detail, and follow-through skills while keeping sight of the bigger picture.

• Excellent presentation skills

• Fluent in English

• Familiarity with AI-generated copy is a plus.

• Proficiency in Asana, Jira, Figma and Google Workspace is a plus

About the Team

The mission of the Marketing Program Management team is to ensure marketing projects are delivered on time and on budget (where required), enabling seamless execution across cross-functional teams.
We operate in a culture of accountability, resourcefulness, and collaboration, fostering an environment where innovation and growth can thrive.
With a strong commitment to excellence, we continuously elevate On’s product and digital copy, pushing creative and executional boundaries season after season.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lead Project Manager - Brand & Product Assets
Team di gestione del programma di marketing globale

Posizione: Zurigo, Berlino, Londra (preferito)

In breve
Nato nelle Alpi svizzere con l’obiettivo di rivoluzionare l’industria dello sportswear, On è diventato il marchio di abbigliamento sportivo più veloce al mondo.
Siamo in una missione per accendere lo spirito umano attraverso il movimento, rimanendo fedeli alle nostre radici profonde nelle prestazioni in esecuzione mentre cresce la nostra rilevanza con coloro che si muovono in altri modi.
Per sostenere questa ambizione, stiamo cercando un direttore di progetto forte con esperienza di agenzia per guidare i nostri progetti Product & Digital Copy.
Questo ruolo si riferirà al Responsabile Marketing Program Management – Brand & Product Assets.

Il ruolo supervisiona e coordina lo sviluppo di copie in una vasta gamma di punti di contatto di consumo e commerciali, tra cui email CRM, pagine di descrizione del prodotto (PDP), strumenti di vendita B2B per partner, e attività di vendita al dettaglio come la copia della parete di calzature. Include anche la denominazione del prodotto e dello stile, lo sviluppo di nuova terminologia (verde), e la copia per hangtags, imballaggio e linee guida del marchio su tutti i verticali e Progetti Speciali.

Questo ruolo assicura che la copia sia strategicamente allineata, consegnata in tempo, ed esprime costantemente la voce del marchio in tutti i canali e mercati.

Se avete esperienza di gestione dei processi di copia, capire che cosa rende un forte brief creativo, e avere una vera passione per il linguaggio, questa potrebbe essere l'occasione giusta per fare il vostro marchio.

In particolare accogliamo i candidati con diverse esperienze di vita e professionali, prospettive e stili di lavoro.

La tua missione

• Gestione del progetto da soli e di guida end-to-end per tutti i progetti di copia prodotto e digitale, assicurando che i brief siano completi e allineati attraverso la validazione interfunzionale proattiva, le uscite di copia riflettono accuratamente il breve, e sia la copia master inglese e le traduzioni vengono consegnate in tempo.

• Collabora con il team Creative Ops per assegnare copywriter e gestire proattivamente il loro carico di lavoro tracciando tempi e priorità.

• Supporta il Responsabile Marketing Program Management – Brand & Product Assets per definire e migliorare continuamente i processi e le modalità di lavoro.

• Promuovere un forte allineamento attraverso il più ampio team di Marketing Program Management per garantire la coerenza in tutti i punti di contatto dei consumatori.

• Monitorare l'efficienza e le metriche chiave delle prestazioni, sfruttando le informazioni guidate dai dati per ottimizzare continuamente e affinare gli approcci per il massimo impatto.

• Identificare e affrontare attivamente potenziali sfide o blocchi stradali, dimostrando agilità e risorse nello sviluppo di soluzioni che mantengono slancio e forniscono risultati forti.

La tua storia

• Un minimo di 5-7 anni di esperienza in Project Management all'interno di un'agenzia di pubblicità creativa è richiesto per questo ruolo.

• Hai la tenacia per risolvere i problemi duri, l'iniziativa eccezionale, l'attenzione ai dettagli e le competenze di follow-through – il tutto con vista del quadro più grande.

• Provato record di traccia nel coordinare con successo più progetti contemporaneamente dall'inizio alla fine.

• Forte comprensione dei processi di copia del prodotto e digitale attraverso le email di CRM, pagine di descrizione del prodotto (PDPs), strumenti di vendita B2B per i partner, e attività di marketing al dettaglio, così come il nome del prodotto e dello stile, lo sviluppo di terminologia sempreverde, e copia per hangtags, imballaggio e linee guida del marchio in tutti i verticali e progetti speciali.

• Eccellente problem solving, gestione del progetto e capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli.

• Capacità di soddisfare tempi stretti, priorità compiti, e trovare soluzioni senza compromettere qualità o positività.

• Eccezionale iniziativa, attenzione ai dettagli e competenze di follow-through pur mantenendo la vista del quadro più grande.

• Eccellente capacità di presentazione

• Fluente in inglese

• La familiarità con l'intelligenza artificiale è un vantaggio.

• La competenza in Asana, Jira, Figma e Google Workspace è un plus

Informazioni sulla squadra

La missione del team Marketing Program Management è garantire che i progetti di marketing vengano consegnati in tempo e sul budget (dove necessario), consentendo l'esecuzione senza soluzione di continuità tra le squadre interfunzionali.
Operiamo in una cultura di responsabilità, risorse e collaborazione, promuovendo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la crescita possono prosperare.
Con un forte impegno per l'eccellenza, eleviamo continuamente il prodotto e la copia digitale di On, spingendo i confini creativi ed esecutivi stagione dopo stagione.

Cosa offriamo

Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico - per rimanere attivo, imparare, esplorare e innovare. descriptionByLocale.en:
Lead Project Manager - Brand & Product Assets
Global Marketing Program Management Team

Location: Zurich, Berlin, London (preferred)

In Short
Born in the Swiss Alps with the goal of revolutionizing the sportswear industry, On has become the world’s fastest-growing premium sportswear brand.
We’re on a mission to ignite the human spirit through movement, staying true to our deep roots in performance running while growing our relevance with those who move in other ways.
To support this ambition, we are looking for a strong project manager with agency experience to drive our Product & Digital Copy projects.
This role will report to the Head of Marketing Program Management – Brand & Product Assets.

The role oversees and coordinates copy development across a wide range of consumer and commercial touchpoints, including CRM emails, product description pages (PDPs), B2B sell-in tools for partners, and retail marketing assets such as footwear wall copy. It also includes product and style naming, development of new terminology (evergreen), and copy for hangtags, packaging, and brand guidelines across all verticals and Special Projects.

This role ensures copy is strategically aligned, delivered on time, and consistently expresses the brand voice across all channels and markets.

If you have experience managing copy processes, understand what makes a strong creative brief, and have a genuine passion for language, this could be the right opportunity to make your mark.

We particularly welcome candidates with diverse life and professional experiences, perspectives, and working styles.

Your Mission

• Own and drive end-to-end project management for all product and digital copy projects, ensuring briefs are complete and aligned through proactive cross-functional validation, copy outputs accurately reflect the brief, and both master English copy and translations are delivered on time.

• Collaborate with the Creative Ops team to allocate copywriters and proactively manage their workload by tracking timelines and prioritization.

• Support the Head of Marketing Program Management – Brand & Product Assets to define and continuously improve processes and ways of working.

• Foster strong alignment across the wider Marketing Program Management team to ensure consistency across all consumer touchpoints.

• Monitor efficiency and key performance metrics, leveraging data-driven insights to continuously optimize and refine approaches for maximum impact.

• Proactively identify and address potential challenges or roadblocks, demonstrating agility and resourcefulness in developing solutions that maintain momentum and deliver strong outcomes.

Your Story

• A minimum of 5-7 years of experience in Project Management within a creative advertising agency is required for this role.

• You have the tenacity to solve hard problems, exceptional initiative, attention to detail and follow-through skills – all with sight of the bigger picture.

• Proven track record in successfully coordinating multiple projects simultaneously from start to finish.

• Strong understanding of product and digital copy processes across CRM emails, product description pages (PDPs), B2B sell-in tools for partners, and retail marketing assets, as well as product and style naming, the development of evergreen terminology, and copy for hangtags, packaging, and brand guidelines across all verticals and special projects.

• Excellent problem-solving, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

• Ability to meet tight timelines, prioritize tasks, and find solutions without compromising quality or positivity.

• Exceptional initiative, attention to detail, and follow-through skills while keeping sight of the bigger picture.

• Excellent presentation skills

• Fluent in English

• Familiarity with AI-generated copy is a plus.

• Proficiency in Asana, Jira, Figma and Google Workspace is a plus

About the Team

The mission of the Marketing Program Management team is to ensure marketing projects are delivered on time and on budget (where required), enabling seamless execution across cross-functional teams.
We operate in a culture of accountability, resourcefulness, and collaboration, fostering an environment where innovation and growth can thrive.
With a strong commitment to excellence, we continuously elevate On’s product and digital copy, pushing creative and executional boundaries season after season.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Lead Project Manager - Brand & Product Assets
Global Marketing Program Management Team

Standort: Zürich, Berlin, London (bevorzugt)

Kurz
Geboren in den Schweizer Alpen mit dem Ziel, die Sportbekleidungsindustrie zu revolutionieren, hat sich On zur weltweit am schnellsten wachsenden Premium-Sportbekleidungsmarke entwickelt.
Wir sind auf der Mission, den menschlichen Geist durch Bewegung zu entzünden, unseren tiefen Wurzeln im Performance-Laufen treu zu bleiben und gleichzeitig unsere Relevanz für diejenigen zu erhöhen, die sich auf andere Weise bewegen.
Um diese Ambition zu unterstützen, suchen wir einen starken Projektmanager mit Agenturerfahrung, der unsere Product & Digital Copy-Projekte vorantreibt.
Diese Rolle wird an den Leiter des Marketingprogramms Management – Brand & Product Assets berichten.

Die Rolle überwacht und koordiniert die Kopierentwicklung über eine Vielzahl von Consumer- und Commercial-Touchpoints, einschließlich CRM-E-Mails, Produktbeschreibungsseiten (PDPs), B2B-Sell-In-Tools für Partner und Retail-Marketing-Assets wie Footwear Wall Copy. Es umfasst auch Produkt- und Stilnamen, die Entwicklung neuer Terminologie (Evergreen) und Kopien für Hangtags, Verpackungen und Markenrichtlinien in allen Branchen und Sonderprojekten.

Diese Rolle stellt sicher, dass die Kopie strategisch ausgerichtet ist, pünktlich geliefert wird und die Markenstimme über alle Kanäle und Märkte hinweg konsistent zum Ausdruck bringt.

Wenn Sie Erfahrung mit der Verwaltung von Kopierprozessen haben, verstehen, was einen starken kreativen Auftrag ausmacht, und eine echte Leidenschaft für Sprache haben, könnte dies die richtige Gelegenheit sein, sich zu profilieren.

Wir begrüßen insbesondere Kandidaten mit unterschiedlichen Lebens- und Berufserfahrungen, Perspektiven und Arbeitsstilen.

Deine Mission

• Eigenes und treibendes End-to-End-Projektmanagement für alle Produkt- und Digitalkopierprojekte, um sicherzustellen, dass die Briefings vollständig und durch proaktive funktionsübergreifende Validierung ausgerichtet sind, die Kopierausgaben das Briefing genau widerspiegeln und sowohl englische Masterkopien als auch Übersetzungen pünktlich geliefert werden.

• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Creative Ops-Team zusammen, um Texter zuzuweisen und ihre Arbeitsbelastung proaktiv zu verwalten, indem Sie Zeitpläne und Prioritäten verfolgen.

• Unterstützen Sie den Head of Marketing Program Management – Brand & Product Assets dabei, Prozesse und Arbeitsweisen zu definieren und kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

• Pflegen Sie eine starke Ausrichtung im gesamten Marketing-Programm-Management-Team, um Konsistenz über alle Verbraucher-Touchpoints zu gewährleisten.

• Überwachen Sie Effizienz und wichtige Leistungskennzahlen, indem Sie datengesteuerte Erkenntnisse nutzen, um Ansätze für maximale Wirkung kontinuierlich zu optimieren und zu verfeinern.

• Proaktive Identifizierung und Bewältigung potenzieller Herausforderungen oder Hindernisse, um Agilität und Einfallsreichtum bei der Entwicklung von Lösungen zu demonstrieren, die Dynamik beibehalten und starke Ergebnisse liefern.

Deine Geschichte

• Ein Minimum von 5-7 Jahren Erfahrung im Projektmanagement innerhalb einer kreativen Werbeagentur ist für diese Rolle erforderlich.

• Sie haben die Hartnäckigkeit, schwierige Probleme zu lösen, außergewöhnliche Initiative, Liebe zum Detail und Folgefähigkeiten - alles mit Blick auf das Gesamtbild.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der erfolgreichen Koordination mehrerer Projekte gleichzeitig von Anfang bis Ende.

• Hervorragende Problemlösungs-, Projektmanagement- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Fähigkeit, enge Zeitpläne einzuhalten, Aufgaben zu priorisieren und Lösungen zu finden, ohne Kompromisse bei Qualität oder Positivität einzugehen.

• Außergewöhnliche Initiative, Liebe zum Detail und Folgefähigkeiten, während Sie das Gesamtbild im Auge behalten.

• Hervorragende Präsentationsfähigkeiten

• Fließend in Englisch

• Vertrautheit mit AI-generierter Kopie ist ein Plus.

• Kenntnisse in Asana, Jira, Figma und Google Workspace sind ein Plus

Über das Team

Die Mission des Marketing-Programm-Management-Teams besteht darin, sicherzustellen, dass Marketingprojekte pünktlich und im Budget (falls erforderlich) geliefert werden, wodurch eine nahtlose Ausführung in funktionsübergreifenden Teams ermöglicht wird.
Wir arbeiten in einer Kultur der Rechenschaftspflicht, des Einfallsreichtums und der Zusammenarbeit und fördern ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Wachstum gedeihen können.
Mit einem starken Engagement für Exzellenz verbessern wir die Produkt- und Digitalkopie von On kontinuierlich und erweitern die kreativen und ausführenden Grenzen von Saison zu Saison.

Was wir anbieten

On ist ein Ort, der sich um Wachstum und Fortschritt dreht. Wir bieten eine Umgebung, die den Menschen die Werkzeuge gibt, sich ganzheitlich zu entwickeln - aktiv zu bleiben, zu lernen, zu erforschen und zu innovieren. Unser unverwechselbarer Ansatz kombiniert eine unterstützende, teamorientierte Atmosphäre mit dem Zugang zu persönlicher Selbstfürsorge für körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden, so dass jede Person von ihrem Zweck geleitet wird.

On ist ein Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber. Wir sind bestrebt, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen in Bezug auf Rekrutierung, Förderung und Bindung frei von Diskriminierung sind.

• Surveiller l'efficacité et les principales mesures de rendement, en tirant parti des données pour optimiser et affiner continuellement les approches afin d'obtenir un impact maximal.

• Vous avez la ténacité de résoudre des problèmes difficiles, l'initiative exceptionnelle, l'attention aux détails et les compétences de suivi – le tout avec la vue d'ensemble.

• Expérience éprouvée dans la coordination de plusieurs projets simultanément du début à la fin.

• Une bonne compréhension des processus de copie de produits et numériques à travers les courriels CRM, les pages de description de produits (PDP), les outils de vente B2B pour les partenaires et les actifs de marketing de détail, ainsi que la désignation de produits et de styles, le développement de la terminologie persistante, et la copie pour les étiquettes de suspension, l'emballage et les lignes directrices de marque pour tous les projets verticaux et spéciaux.

• Excellente capacité de résolution de problèmes, de gestion de projets et de communication, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec les intervenants à tous les niveaux.

• Capacité de respecter des délais serrés, de prioriser les tâches et de trouver des solutions sans compromettre la qualité ou la positivité.

• Initiative exceptionnelle, attention au détail et compétences de suivi tout en gardant la vue d'ensemble.

• Excellentes compétences en présentation

• Fluent en anglais

• La familiarité avec la copie générée par l'IA est un plus.

• Compétence en Asana, Jira, Figma et Google Workspace est un plus

À propos de l'équipe

L'équipe de gestion du programme de marketing a pour mission de veiller à ce que les projets de marketing soient exécutés dans les délais et selon le budget (au besoin), ce qui permettra une exécution transparente entre les équipes interfonctionnelles.
Nous travaillons dans une culture de responsabilité, d'ingéniosité et de collaboration, favorisant un environnement où l'innovation et la croissance peuvent prospérer.
Avec un engagement fort envers l'excellence, nous élevons continuellement le produit et la copie numérique, poussant les limites créatives et exécutionnelles saison après saison.

Ce que nous offrons

Sur est un endroit qui est centré sur la croissance et le progrès. Nous offrons un environnement conçu pour donner aux gens les outils pour se développer de manière holistique – rester actifs, apprendre, explorer et innover. Notre approche particulière combine une atmosphère de soutien et d'équipe, avec l'accès à des soins personnels pour le bien-être physique et mental, de sorte que chaque personne est dirigée par but.

jobs.title: Lead - Polymer Process Engineer, Lightspray
jobs.description:
In short
 Join us at the heart of the revolution. As a hands-on Lead Process Engineer at our LightSpray production sites, you will be the critical link between engineering and live operations. You will support a growing production system, ensuring this disruptive technology is robust, repeatable, and ready to scale.
As the Lead Process Engineer, you will own the day-to-day process stability, execute experimental designs (DoE), and drive root cause analysis on faulty products. Working closely with the Senior Lead Process Engineer, you will support process validation, contribute to novel process development, and lead field deployment of LightSpray machinery across global sites.

Your mission
 - Drive Data-Driven Process Validation: Execute experimental designs (DoE) and process validation protocols to ensure repeatability and robustness for high-volume manufacturing.
- Hands-On Machine & Product Troubleshooting: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for machine parameters and material processing issues. Perform root cause analysis to resolve critical process deviations and product defects.
- Support Deployment & Global Readiness (Up to 20% Travel): Visit global production sites to support machine readiness, assist with equipment deployment, and translate factory floor feedback into technical improvements.
- Bridge Innovation to Production: Execute process-related tasks on multidisciplinary projects, bridging material and process innovations from the lab to production lines.
- Documentation & SOPs: Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) based on real-time operational feedback to ensure process repeatability across sites.

Your story
 - Degree in Engineering, Material Science background or an apprenticeship in polymer processing or automation
- 6+ years of Industry Experience: Solid track record in process execution, machine troubleshooting, and process validation within polymer processing or related manufacturing technologies.
- Practical experience executing experiments, handling machine parameters, and performing on-site troubleshooting.
- Knowledge of pneumatic systems, the ability to understand wiring schematics, and experience wiring electrical components is a big plus.
- Demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis and work systematically using data-driven approaches.
- Willingness to travel globally up to 20% for equipment deployment and site support, with strong cross-functional communication skills.
- Fluent in English (written and spoken).

Meet the team
 As a member of the Innovation Technology Engineering team, you will join a multidisciplinary collective of experts redefining the future of sports goods manufacturing. We bridge the gap between digital theory and physical industrialization by building bespoke machinery, processing novel materials, and leveraging advanced modeling and simulation. Our mission is to unlock the potential of next-generation manufacturing through LightSpray technology.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve
Unisciti a noi nel cuore della rivoluzione. Come pratico Lead Process Engineer presso i nostri siti di produzione LightSpray, sarete il collegamento critico tra l'ingegneria e le operazioni dal vivo. Sosterrai un sistema di produzione in crescita, garantendo che questa tecnologia dirompente sia robusta, ripetibile e pronta a scalare.
Come Lead Process Engineer, si possiede la stabilità di processo giorno per giorno, eseguire progetti sperimentali (DoE), e guidare l'analisi della causa radice sui prodotti difettosi. Lavorando a stretto contatto con il Senior Lead Process Engineer, supporterete la validazione del processo, contribuite allo sviluppo di nuovi processi e alla distribuzione del campo di piombo dei macchinari LightSpray in tutti i siti globali.

La tua missione
- Convalida del processo Data-Driven: Esegui i progetti sperimentali (DoE) e i protocolli di convalida del processo per garantire la ripetibilità e la robustezza per la produzione ad alto volume.
- Risoluzione dei problemi della macchina e del prodotto: servire come punto di contatto tecnico primario per i parametri della macchina e i problemi di elaborazione dei materiali. Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice per risolvere deviazioni di processo critiche e difetti del prodotto.
- Support Deployment & Global Readiness (Up to 30% Travel): Visita i siti di produzione globali per supportare la prontezza della macchina, assistere con l'implementazione delle attrezzature e tradurre il feedback del pavimento in fabbrica in miglioramenti tecnici.
- Bridge Innovation to Production: Esegui i compiti legati al processo su progetti multidisciplinari, bridging material and process innovations from the lab to production lines.
- Documentazione & SOP: Sviluppare e mantenere procedure operative standard (SOP) basate su feedback operativi in tempo reale per garantire la ripetibilità dei processi in tutti i siti.

La tua storia
- Laurea in ingegneria, scienza dei materiali o un apprendistato nella lavorazione dei polimeri o nell'automazione
- 6+ anni di Industry Experience: Solid track record in esecuzione del processo, risoluzione dei problemi della macchina e validazione del processo all'interno della lavorazione dei polimeri o delle relative tecnologie di produzione.
- Esperienza pratica che esegue esperimenti, la gestione dei parametri della macchina e l'esecuzione di risoluzione dei problemi in loco.
- Conoscenza dei sistemi pneumatici, la capacità di capire gli schemi di cablaggio, e l'esperienza di cablaggio componenti elettrici è un grande vantaggio.
- Dimostrata capacità di eseguire analisi causa radice e lavorare sistematicamente utilizzando approcci basati sui dati.
- Volontà di viaggiare a livello globale fino al 20% per l'implementazione di attrezzature e supporto del sito, con forti capacità di comunicazione interfunzionale.
- Fluente in inglese (scritto e parlato).

Incontra la squadra
Come membro del team di Innovation Technology Engineering, si unirà a un collettivo multidisciplinare di esperti che ridefiniscono il futuro della produzione di beni sportivi. Colpiamo il divario tra la teoria digitale e l'industrializzazione fisica costruendo macchinari su misura, elaborando materiali nuovi e sfruttando la modellazione e la simulazione avanzate. La nostra missione è di sbloccare il potenziale della produzione di nuova generazione attraverso la tecnologia LightSpray.

Cosa offriamo
Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico - per rimanere attivo, imparare, esplorare e innovare. Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera solida e orientata al team, con l'accesso all'autocura personale sia per il benessere fisico che mentale, quindi ogni persona è guidata dallo scopo.

Su è una parità di opportunità datori di lavoro. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, all'avanzamento e alla conservazione sono libere di discriminazione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz gesagt
Begleiten Sie uns im Herzen der Revolution. Sie unterstützen ein wachsendes Produktionssystem und stellen sicher, dass diese disruptive Technologie robust, wiederholbar und skalierbar ist.
Als Lead Process Engineer besitzen Sie die tägliche Prozessstabilität, führen experimentelle Designs (DoE) aus und führen eine Ursachenanalyse für fehlerhafte Produkte durch. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Senior Lead Process Engineer unterstützen Sie die Prozessvalidierung, tragen zur neuartigen Prozessentwicklung bei und leiten den Einsatz von LightSpray-Maschinen an globalen Standorten.

Deine Mission
- Drive Data-Driven Process Validation: Führen Sie experimentelle Designs (DoE) und Prozessvalidierungsprotokolle aus, um Wiederholbarkeit und Robustheit für die Großserienfertigung zu gewährleisten.
- Hands-On Machine & Product Troubleshooting: Dienen Sie als primärer technischer Ansprechpartner für Maschinenparameter und Materialbearbeitungsprobleme. Führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse durch, um kritische Prozessabweichungen und Produktfehler zu beheben.
- Support Deployment & Global Readiness (bis zu 30 % Reisebereitschaft): Besuchen Sie globale Produktionsstandorte, um die Maschinenbereitschaft zu unterstützen, die Bereitstellung von Ausrüstung zu unterstützen und das Feedback der Fabrikhallen in technische Verbesserungen umzusetzen.
- Bridge Innovation to Production: Prozessbezogene Aufgaben in multidisziplinären Projekten ausführen und Material- und Prozessinnovationen vom Labor bis zur Produktionslinie verbinden.
- Dokumentation & SOPs: Entwicklung und Pflege von Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) basierend auf Echtzeit-Betriebsfeedback, um die Wiederholbarkeit von Prozessen über Standorte hinweg zu gewährleisten.

Deine Geschichte
- Abschluss in Engineering, Material Science Hintergrund oder eine Lehre in der Polymerverarbeitung oder Automatisierung
- 6+ Jahre Industrieerfahrung: Solide Erfolgsbilanz in der Prozessausführung, Fehlerbehebung und Prozessvalidierung innerhalb der Polymerverarbeitung oder verwandter Fertigungstechnologien.
- Praktische Erfahrung bei der Durchführung von Experimenten, beim Umgang mit Maschinenparametern und bei der Fehlerbehebung vor Ort.

On ist ein Ort, der sich um Wachstum und Fortschritt dreht. En étroite collaboration avec l'ingénieur principal du processus, vous soutiendrez la validation du processus, contribuerez au développement de nouveaux processus et dirigerez le déploiement de machines LightSpray sur les sites mondiaux.

Votre mission
- Validation de processus d'entraînement de données : Exécuter des modèles expérimentaux (DoE) et des protocoles de validation de processus pour assurer la répétabilité et la robustesse pour la fabrication en grand volume.
- Dépannage manuel et produit : servir de point de contact technique principal pour les paramètres de la machine et les problèmes de traitement des matériaux. Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes pour résoudre les écarts critiques du processus et les défauts du produit.

- Documentation et PON : Élaborer et maintenir des procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON) en fonction de la rétroaction opérationnelle en temps réel afin d'assurer la répétabilité des processus dans tous les sites.

Votre histoire
- Diplôme en ingénierie, en science des matériaux ou en apprentissage en polymère ou en automatisation
- 6+ ans d'expérience dans l'industrie : Une solide expérience dans l'exécution des procédés, le dépannage des machines et la validation des procédés au sein du traitement des polymères ou des technologies de fabrication connexes.
- Expérience pratique dans l'exécution d'expériences, la manipulation des paramètres de la machine et le dépannage sur place.
- La connaissance des systèmes pneumatiques, la capacité de comprendre les schémas de câblage et l'expérience de câblage composants électriques est un grand plus.
- Capacité démontrée d'effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et de travailler systématiquement à l'aide d'approches fondées sur les données.
- Volonté de voyager à l'échelle mondiale jusqu'à 20 % pour le déploiement de l'équipement et le soutien au site, avec de solides compétences en communication interfonctionnelle.
- Fluent en anglais (écrit et parlé).

En tant que membre de l'équipe Innovation Technology Engineering, vous rejoindrez un collectif multidisciplinaire d'experts redéfinissant l'avenir de la fabrication de biens sportifs. jobs.title: Lead - Pattern Engineer
jobs.description:
In short

At On, the perfect fit is engineered, not guessed. We are looking for a highly skilled Pattern Engineer to elevate our footwear uppers by establishing robust pattern standards and bringing our innovative designs to life.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between 2D concepts and 3D realities, working closely with Design, Development, Last Engineering, and Manufacturing. You will champion best practices and precise engineering, ensuring our inline footwear collections deliver the exact fit, performance, and quality our global community expects.

Your Mission

• Pattern Standards & Development: Develop, establish, and implement comprehensive pattern standards for inline footwear, outlining best practices, construction methods, and strict quality benchmarks.

• Pattern & Last Synergy: Collaborate deeply with the Last Engineering team to ensure upper patterns and footwear lasts complement each other perfectly, optimizing designs for mass production without compromising comfort or aesthetic goals.

• Prototype Refinement: Lead the transition from digital design to physical sample. Oversee the prototype refinement process, addressing fit, construction, or performance concerns, and feeding those solutions back into our standard practices.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Inline Product Designers, Upper Engineers, and Manufacturing teams. Guide them on adhering to standards while ensuring production feasibility and aligning with the overall design vision.

• Documentation & Training: Create clear, comprehensive documentation outlining pattern standards. Conduct training sessions to educate internal teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and precise execution.

• Continuous Improvement: Regularly assess inline footwear patterns against established standards. Proactively research and incorporate industry advancements, new construction methods, and software capabilities to elevate our product.

• Sustainable Pattern Engineering: Champion On’s sustainability goals by optimizing pattern nesting, material yield, and cutting efficiency to minimize waste. Leverage your deep understanding of sustainable and innovative materials to anticipate how they impact pattern behavior during the manufacturing process.

• Mentorship & Strategic Leadership: Lead, mentor, and elevate creation teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

Your Story

• Pattern Engineering Experience: 8+ years of proven, hands-on experience in footwear pattern engineering, demonstrating successful integration of pattern standards into the product development process.

• Technical Proficiency: Advanced skills in 2D and 3D pattern-making software/CAD tools (e.g., Romans CAD, Dimension, Jevero, MindCAD).

• Material & Construction Knowledge: Deep understanding of footwear upper materials, textiles, and modern construction techniques relevant to performance and lifestyle footwear.

• Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex fit, comfort, and manufacturability challenges within standardized patterns.

• Attention to Detail: A meticulous, detail-oriented mindset with an unwavering commitment to precision and quality in pattern execution.

• Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to promote collaboration, educate team members, and translate technical constraints to creative design teams.

• Global Factory Collaboration: Proven track record of collaborating closely with Tier 1 (T1) development facilities and overseas manufacturing partners. Must possess strong cross-cultural communication skills and a willingness to travel internationally to oversee sampling, troubleshoot complex technical issues on the factory floor, and ensure seamless commercialization.

About the team
 The Footwear Engineering team is a highly specialized collective of Pattern Engineers, Tooling Engineers, and Last Engineers who hold the keys to the ultimate fit, feel, and ride of every On shoe. Rooted in our proud heritage of meticulous Swiss engineering, we obsess over every millimeter and material to craft the absolute best performance products for elite athletes and everyday consumers alike. We are the critical bridge between radical design and physical reality, working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment where data-driven precision fuels our relentless dedication to human movement.

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

A On, la vestibilità perfetta è ingegnerizzata, non indovinata. Siamo alla ricerca di un Pattern Engineer altamente qualificato per elevare le nostre tomaie calzature stabilendo robusti standard di modello e portando i nostri progetti innovativi alla vita.

In questo ruolo, colperai il divario tra i concetti 2D e le realtà 3D, lavorando a stretto contatto con Design, Sviluppo, Last Engineering e Manufacturing. Potrai sostenere le migliori pratiche e l'ingegneria precisa, assicurando che le nostre collezioni di calzature in linea forniscono la misura esatta, le prestazioni e la qualità che la nostra comunità globale si aspetta.

La tua missione

• Pattern Standards & Development: Sviluppare, stabilire e implementare standard di modello completi per calzature in linea, delineando le migliori pratiche, metodi di costruzione e benchmark di qualità rigorosi.

• Pattern & Last Synergy: Collabora profondamente con il team di Last Engineering per garantire modelli e calzature superiori si completano perfettamente, ottimizzando i progetti per la produzione di massa senza compromettere comfort o obiettivi estetici.

• Prototipo di raffinazione: portare la transizione dal design digitale al campione fisico. Controllare il processo di raffinazione del prototipo, affrontare problemi di vestibilità, costruzione o prestazioni, e alimentare queste soluzioni nelle nostre pratiche standard.

• Collaborazione trasversale: Partner con i progettisti di prodotti in linea, gli ingegneri superiori e i team di produzione. Guidateli sull'aderenza agli standard garantendo al contempo la fattibilità della produzione e l'allineamento con la visione generale del design.

• Documentazione & formazione: Creare chiari e completi standard di schema di outlining documentazione. Condurre sessioni di formazione per educare i team interni, promuovere una cultura di miglioramento continuo e esecuzione precisa.

• Miglioramento continuo: Valuta regolarmente i modelli di calzature in linea contro gli standard stabiliti. Proattivamente la ricerca e incorporare progressi del settore, nuovi metodi di costruzione e capacità software per elevare il nostro prodotto.

• Ingegneria del modello sostenibile: Campione Obiettivi di sostenibilità ottimizzando la nidificazione dei modelli, la resa dei materiali e riducendo l’efficienza per ridurre al minimo i rifiuti. Sfrutta la tua profonda comprensione dei materiali sostenibili e innovativi per anticipare il loro impatto sul comportamento dei modelli durante il processo di produzione.

• Mentorship & Strategic Leadership: Leader, mentore e elevare team di creazione, promuovendo una cultura di eccellenza tecnica e apprendimento continuo.

La tua storia

• Esperienza di ingegneria del modello: 8+ anni di comprovata esperienza pratica nell'ingegneria del modello di calzature, dimostrando l'integrazione di successo degli standard di modello nel processo di sviluppo del prodotto.

• Proficienza tecnica: competenze avanzate in 2D e 3D software di modellazione/CAD strumenti (ad esempio, Romans CAD, Dimension, Jevero, MindCAD).

• Conoscenza dei materiali e delle costruzioni: profonda comprensione dei materiali superiori delle calzature, dei tessili e delle moderne tecniche di costruzione relative alle calzature per performance e stile di vita.

• Competenze di problem-solving: Forte capacità analitica di risolvere e risolvere complesse sfide di vestibilità, comfort e manufacturability all'interno di modelli standardizzati.

• Attenzione al dettaglio: Una mente meticolosa, orientata al dettaglio, con un impegno costante di precisione e qualità nell'esecuzione dei modelli.

• Competenze di comunicazione: eccellenti competenze interpersonali e di comunicazione, con una comprovata capacità di promuovere la collaborazione, educare i membri del team, e tradurre vincoli tecnici ai team di progettazione creativa.

• Global Factory Collaboration: Proven track record di collaborazione con Tier 1 (T1) strutture di sviluppo e partner di produzione all'estero. Deve possedere forti capacità di comunicazione interculturale e la volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale per supervisionare il campionamento, risolvere problemi tecnici complessi al piano di fabbrica, e garantire la commercializzazione senza soluzione di continuità.

Informazioni sulla squadra
Il team di Footwear Engineering è un collettivo altamente specializzato di Pattern Engineers, Tooling Engineers, e Last Engineers che tengono le chiavi per la vestibilità, la sensazione e la corsa di ogni Su scarpa. Nato nella nostra orgogliosa eredità di meticolosa ingegneria svizzera, ossessioniamo ogni millimetro e materiale per creare i migliori prodotti di performance assoluti sia per gli atleti che per i consumatori di ogni giorno. Siamo il ponte critico tra il design radicale e la realtà fisica, lavorando in un ambiente veloce e altamente collaborativo dove la precisione data-driven alimenta la nostra incessante dedizione al movimento umano.

Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico – per rimanere attivi, per imparare, esplorare e innovare. Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera solida e orientata al team, con l'accesso all'autocura personale sia per il benessere fisico che mentale, quindi ogni persona è guidata dallo scopo.

Su è una parità di opportunità datori di lavoro. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, all'avanzamento e alla conservazione sono libere di discriminazione.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref

À On, l'ajustement parfait est conçu, pas deviné. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur de motif hautement qualifié pour élever nos dessus de chaussures en établissant des normes de modèle robustes et en mettant à jour nos conceptions innovantes.

Dans ce rôle, vous comblerez l'écart entre les concepts 2D et les réalités 3D, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec Design, Development, Last Engineering et Manufacturing. Vous serez champions des meilleures pratiques et de l'ingénierie précise, assurant que nos collections de chaussures en ligne offrent l'ajustement exact, la performance et la qualité que notre communauté mondiale attend.

Votre mission

• Normes et développement des modèles : Élaborer, établir et mettre en oeuvre des normes détaillées pour les modèles de chaussures en ligne, en décrivant les meilleures pratiques, les méthodes de construction et les critères de qualité stricts.

• Pattern & Last Synergy: Collaborez étroitement avec l'équipe de Last Engineering pour s'assurer que les motifs supérieurs et les chaussures se complètent parfaitement, optimisant les conceptions pour la production de masse sans compromettre le confort ou les objectifs esthétiques.

• Prototype : Diriger la transition de la conception numérique à l'échantillon physique. Surveillez le processus de raffinement du prototype, en abordant les problèmes d'ajustement, de construction ou de performance et en réintégrant ces solutions dans nos pratiques standard.

• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : partenaire avec les concepteurs de produits en ligne, les ingénieurs supérieurs et les équipes de fabrication. Guidez-les sur le respect des normes tout en assurant la faisabilité de la production et l'alignement sur la vision globale de la conception.

• Documentation et formation : Créer une documentation claire et complète décrivant les normes de configuration. Organiser des séances de formation pour éduquer les équipes internes, favoriser une culture d'amélioration continue et d'exécution précise.

• Amélioration continue : Évaluer régulièrement les modèles de chaussures en ligne par rapport aux normes établies. Recherche proactive et intégration des progrès de l'industrie, des nouvelles méthodes de construction et des capacités logicielles pour élever notre produit.

• Ingénierie de motif durable: Champion Sur les objectifs de durabilité en optimisant les patrons de nidification, le rendement des matériaux et l'efficacité de coupe pour minimiser les déchets. Tirez profit de votre compréhension approfondie des matériaux durables et innovants pour anticiper leur impact sur le comportement du modèle pendant le processus de fabrication.

• Mentorship et leadership stratégique : Diriger, encadrer et élever les équipes de création, favoriser une culture d'excellence technique et d'apprentissage continu.

Votre histoire

• Expérience en ingénierie des modèles : 8 ans et plus d'expérience pratique éprouvée en ingénierie des modèles de chaussures, démontrant l'intégration réussie des normes relatives aux modèles dans le processus de développement des produits.

• Compétences techniques : Compétences avancées dans les logiciels de création de motifs 2D et 3D (p. ex., Romans CAD, Dimension, Jevero, MindCAD).

• Connaissance des matériaux et de la construction : Compréhension approfondie des matériaux de dessus de chaussures, des textiles et des techniques de construction modernes pertinentes pour les chaussures de performance et de style de vie.

• Compétences de résolution des problèmes : Forte capacité d'analyse pour résoudre les problèmes complexes d'ajustement, de confort et de fabrication dans des modèles normalisés.

• Attention au détail: Un état d'esprit méticuleux et axé sur les détails, avec un engagement indéfectible en matière de précision et de qualité dans l'exécution des motifs.

• Compétences en communication : Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et en communication, avec une capacité prouvée de promouvoir la collaboration, d'éduquer les membres de l'équipe et de traduire les contraintes techniques aux équipes de conception créative.

• Collaboration mondiale avec les usines : Expérience éprouvée de collaboration étroite avec les installations de développement de niveau 1 (T1) et les partenaires de fabrication étrangers. Il doit posséder de solides compétences en communication interculturelle et être disposé à voyager à l'étranger pour superviser l'échantillonnage, résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes au niveau de l'usine et assurer une commercialisation transparente.

À propos de l'équipe
L'équipe d'ingénierie de chaussures est un collectif hautement spécialisé de Pattern Engineers, Tooling Engineers et Last Engineers qui détiennent les clés de l'ajustement, de la sensation et de la conduite ultime de chaque chaussure On. S'inspirant de notre fière tradition d'ingénierie suisse méticuleuse, nous sommes obsédés par tous les millimètres et matériaux pour fabriquer les meilleurs produits de performance absolus pour les athlètes d'élite et les consommateurs quotidiens. Nous sommes le pont critique entre la conception radicale et la réalité physique, travaillant dans un environnement de collaboration rapide et très collaboratif où la précision basée sur les données alimente notre dévouement inlassable au mouvement humain.

Sur est un endroit qui est centré sur la croissance et le progrès. Nous offrons un environnement conçu pour donner aux gens les outils pour se développer de manière holistique – rester actifs, apprendre, explorer et innover. Notre approche distinctive combine une atmosphère de soutien et d'équipe, avec l'accès à des soins personnels pour le bien-être physique et mental, de sorte que chaque personne est dirigée par but.

Il y a un employeur de l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes déterminés à créer un milieu de travail équitable et inclusif, où toutes les décisions liées au recrutement, à l'avancement et au maintien en poste sont exemptes de discrimination.

jobs.title: Lead - Inbound Transportation Operations

titleByLocale.it: Piombo - Operazioni di trasporto in entrata

jobs.description:
In short
 We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive Inbound Transport Operations Lead for our Zurich-based Global Inbound Transportation Team. Reporting directly to the Head of Inbound Transportation Operations, you will drive the execution of strategic transport initiatives and enhance delivery performance by ensuring our products flow from our suppliers to our warehouses for your assigned markets efficiently and on time. Your will play a pivotal role in managing and evolving our transport operations to boost performance, foster proactive shipment oversight, and streamline our transportation network.

Your mission
 - Drive key strategic initiatives for Transport Operations, including supporting the establishment of transport flows to new warehouses, onboarding of Logistics Service Providers, and scaling of Direct Ship operations.
- Lead and optimize inbound delivery performance for a specific market, ensuring timely and cost-effective product flows from factories to warehouses across diverse modes of shipment (air, sea, road), and guaranteeing rigorous adherence to SLAs and lead-time benchmarks.
- Establish strong partnerships with LSPs, Regional Operations, Customs and Supply Planning mitigating supply chain disruptions proactively, driving continuous improvement and enforcing accountability across all stakeholders
- Co-lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with LSPs and market-level reviews to evaluate KPIs, drive continuous improvement, and hold all stakeholders accountable.
- Lead initiatives to standardize, align, and re-assess global transport operations requirements across providers and destinations.
- Foster best practice sharing, driving standardization and harmonization where beneficial while maintaining agility for local market needs.

Your story
 - A degree in business, economics, logistics, planning, supply chain, information systems, or operations; MBA a is a plus.
- +7 years of work experience in global transport operations ideally in an apparel/fashion global supply chain management or freight forwarding/carrier industry. Additional supply chain experience in other areas such as, procurement, sourcing, supply planning, and warehousing is an asset.
- Extensive knowledge and operational experience across all modes of transport, including airfreight, seafreight, truck, and courier services.
- Strong analytical, structured and data driven mindset.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both oral and written, to interact effectively with different teams and stakeholders
- Proficiency in English. Other languages are a plus.
- Ability to work and deliver in changing environments, under very limited guidance while adhering to specified deadlines.

Meet the team
 The Inbound Transportation Team works closely to strive for excellence in everything we do, to ensure that products from our suppliers to the warehouses globally are delivered in a timely and optimal manner. We are data-driven but are also action-oriented and are able to multi-task. We establish and follow processes, but are also continuously challenging the status quo and industry standards.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve
Stiamo cercando un leader di operazioni di trasporto in entrata altamente esperto e proattivo per il nostro Global Inbound Transportation Team di Zurigo. Segnalando direttamente al responsabile delle operazioni di trasporto in entrata, guiderai l'esecuzione di iniziative di trasporto strategiche e aumenterai le prestazioni di consegna assicurando che i nostri prodotti fluiscano dai nostri fornitori ai nostri magazzini per i tuoi mercati assegnati in modo efficiente e puntuale. Il vostro ruolo sarà fondamentale nella gestione e nell'evoluzione delle nostre operazioni di trasporto per aumentare le prestazioni, promuovere la supervisione della spedizione proattiva e ottimizzare la nostra rete di trasporto.

La tua missione
- Guidare iniziative strategiche chiave per le operazioni di trasporto, tra cui sostenere la creazione di flussi di trasporto a nuovi magazzini, a bordo dei fornitori di servizi logistici, e scaling delle operazioni navali dirette.
- Condurre e ottimizzare le prestazioni di consegna in entrata per un mercato specifico, assicurando flussi di prodotti tempestivi e convenienti da fabbriche a magazzini attraverso diversi modi di spedizione (aria, mare, strada), e garantendo una rigorosa aderenza a SLAs e benchmark lead-time.
- Stabilire partnership forti con LSP, Operazioni Regionali, Dogane e Pianificazione dei Fornitori mitigando le interruzioni della supply chain proattivamente, guidando il miglioramento continuo e rafforzando la responsabilità in tutti gli stakeholder
- Co-lead mensile e trimestrale recensioni aziendali con LSP e recensioni a livello di mercato per valutare KPI, guidare il miglioramento continuo, e tenere conto di tutti gli stakeholder.
- Condurre iniziative per standardizzare, allineare e rivalutare i requisiti globali di operazioni di trasporto tra fornitori e destinazioni.
- Promuovere la migliore condivisione delle pratiche, la standardizzazione di guida e l'armonizzazione dove utile pur mantenendo l'agilità per le esigenze del mercato locale.

La tua storia
- Laurea in economia, economia, logistica, pianificazione, supply chain, sistemi informativi, o operazioni; MBA a è un plus.
- +7 anni di esperienza lavorativa nelle operazioni di trasporto globale idealmente in una gestione della supply chain globale di abbigliamento/fashion o invio merci/industria del trasporto. Ulteriori esperienze di supply chain in altri settori come, approvvigionamento, approvvigionamento, pianificazione della fornitura, e warehousing è un bene.
- Ampia conoscenza e esperienza operativa in tutti i modi di trasporto, tra cui airfreight, seafreight, camion e servizi di corriere.
- Forte mentalità analitica, strutturata e guidata dai dati.
- Eccellente capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione, sia orale che scritta, per interagire efficacemente con diversi team e stakeholder
- Competenza in inglese. Altre lingue sono un plus.
- Capacità di lavorare e consegnare in ambienti mutevoli, sotto una guida molto limitata, aderendo a determinate scadenze.

Incontra la squadra
Il team di trasporto in entrata lavora a stretto contatto per cercare l'eccellenza in tutto ciò che facciamo, per garantire che i prodotti dai nostri fornitori ai magazzini a livello globale vengano consegnati in modo tempestivo e ottimale. Siamo dati-driven, ma sono anche orientati all'azione e sono in grado di multi-task. Istituiamo e seguiamo i processi, ma stiamo sfidando continuamente lo status quo e gli standard del settore.

Cosa offriamo
Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico - per rimanere attivo, imparare, esplorare e innovare. Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera solida e orientata al team, con l'accesso all'autocura personale sia per il benessere fisico che mentale, quindi ogni persona è guidata dallo scopo.

Su è una parità di opportunità datori di lavoro. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, all'avanzamento e alla conservazione sono libere di discriminazione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz gesagt
Wir suchen einen erfahrenen und proaktiven Inbound Transport Operations Lead für unser in Zürich ansässiges Global Inbound Transportation Team. Wenn Sie direkt an den Head of Inbound Transportation Operations berichten, werden Sie die Durchführung strategischer Transportinitiativen vorantreiben und die Lieferleistung verbessern, indem Sie sicherstellen, dass unsere Produkte effizient und pünktlich von unseren Lieferanten zu unseren Lagern für Ihre zugewiesenen Märkte gelangen. Sie werden eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Transportvorgänge spielen, um die Leistung zu steigern, eine proaktive Versandaufsicht zu fördern und unser Transportnetzwerk zu optimieren.

Deine Mission
- Förderung wichtiger strategischer Initiativen für den Transportbetrieb, einschließlich der Unterstützung der Einrichtung von Transportströmen zu neuen Lagerhallen, der Einbindung von Logistikdienstleistern und der Skalierung des Direktschiffbetriebs.
- Führen und optimieren Sie die Inbound-Lieferleistung für einen bestimmten Markt, gewährleisten Sie zeitnahe und kostengünstige Produktflüsse von Fabriken zu Lagerhäusern über verschiedene Versandarten (Luft, See, Straße) und garantieren Sie die strikte Einhaltung von SLAs und Vorlaufzeit-Benchmarks.
- Etablieren Sie starke Partnerschaften mit LSPs, Regional Operations, Customs and Supply Planning, um Störungen der Lieferkette proaktiv zu mindern, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben und die Rechenschaftspflicht aller Beteiligten durchzusetzen
- Führen Sie monatliche und vierteljährliche Geschäftsüberprüfungen mit LSPs und Marktbewertungen, um KPIs zu bewerten, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben und alle Stakeholder zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen.
- Führen Sie Initiativen zur Standardisierung, Angleichung und Neubewertung globaler Transportanforderungen für Anbieter und Destinationen.
- Förderung des Austauschs von Best Practices, Förderung der Standardisierung und Harmonisierung, wo dies von Vorteil ist, während die Agilität für lokale Marktbedürfnisse erhalten bleibt.

Deine Geschichte
- Ein Abschluss in Wirtschaft, Wirtschaft, Logistik, Planung, Lieferkette, Informationssysteme oder Operationen; MBA a ist ein Plus.
- +7 Jahre Berufserfahrung im globalen Transportbetrieb idealerweise in einer Bekleidung / Mode globalen Supply Chain Management oder Spedition / Carrier Industrie. Zusätzliche Supply-Chain-Erfahrung in anderen Bereichen wie Beschaffung, Beschaffung, Versorgungsplanung und Lagerhaltung ist ein Gewinn.
- Umfangreiche Kenntnisse und Betriebserfahrung in allen Verkehrsträgern, einschließlich Luftfracht, Seefracht, LKW und Kurierdienste.
- Starke analytische, strukturierte und datengesteuerte Denkweise.
- Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich, um effektiv mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern zu interagieren
- Englischkenntnisse. Andere Sprachen sind ein Plus.
- Fähigkeit, in wechselnden Umgebungen unter sehr begrenzter Anleitung zu arbeiten und zu liefern, während die festgelegten Fristen eingehalten werden.

Treffen Sie das Team
Das Inbound Transportation Team arbeitet eng zusammen, um bei allem, was wir tun, nach Exzellenz zu streben, um sicherzustellen, dass Produkte von unseren Lieferanten bis zu den Lagern weltweit rechtzeitig und optimal geliefert werden. Wir sind datengesteuert, aber auch aktionsorientiert und können multi-tasking. Wir etablieren und verfolgen Prozesse, stellen aber auch den Status quo und die Industriestandards ständig in Frage.

Was wir anbieten
On ist ein Ort, der sich um Wachstum und Fortschritt dreht. Wir bieten eine Umgebung, die den Menschen die Werkzeuge gibt, sich ganzheitlich zu entwickeln - aktiv zu bleiben, zu lernen, zu erforschen und zu innovieren. Unser unverwechselbarer Ansatz kombiniert eine unterstützende, teamorientierte Atmosphäre mit dem Zugang zu persönlicher Selbstfürsorge für körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden, so dass jede Person von ihrem Zweck geleitet wird.

On ist ein Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber. Wir sind bestrebt, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen in Bezug auf Rekrutierung, Förderung und Bindung frei von Diskriminierung sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref
Nous recherchons un responsable des opérations de transport entrant hautement expérimenté et proactif pour notre équipe mondiale de transport entrant basée à Zurich. Relevant directement du responsable des opérations de transport entrant, vous dirigerez l'exécution d'initiatives de transport stratégique et améliorerez les performances de livraison en assurant le flux de nos produits de nos fournisseurs vers nos entrepôts pour vos marchés assignés efficacement et à temps. Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la gestion et l'évolution de nos opérations de transport afin d'accroître la performance, de favoriser la surveillance proactive des expéditions et de rationaliser notre réseau de transport.

Votre mission
- Diriger les principales initiatives stratégiques pour les opérations de transport, y compris l'appui à l'établissement de flux de transport vers de nouveaux entrepôts, à l'embarquement des fournisseurs de services logistiques et à l'élargissement des opérations directes des navires.
- Diriger et optimiser les performances de livraison à l'arrivée pour un marché donné, en assurant des flux de produits rapides et rentables entre les usines et les entrepôts à travers divers modes d'expédition (air, mer, route), et en garantissant le respect rigoureux des normes SLA et des délais d'exécution.
- Établir des partenariats solides avec les PSL, les Opérations régionales, la Planification des douanes et des approvisionnements pour atténuer les perturbations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de façon proactive, favoriser l'amélioration continue et faire respecter la responsabilisation de tous les intervenants
- Codiriger les examens d'affaires mensuels et trimestriels avec les FSL et les examens du marché pour évaluer les ICR, favoriser l'amélioration continue et tenir tous les intervenants responsables.
- Diriger les initiatives visant à normaliser, harmoniser et réévaluer les exigences en matière d'opérations de transport mondiales entre les fournisseurs et les destinations.
- Favoriser le partage des meilleures pratiques, la normalisation et l'harmonisation lorsque cela est bénéfique tout en maintenant l'agilité pour les besoins du marché local.

Votre histoire
- Diplôme en affaires, économie, logistique, planification, chaîne d'approvisionnement, systèmes d'information ou opérations; MBA a est un plus.
- +7 ans d'expérience dans les opérations de transport mondial idéalement dans une gestion globale de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou de fret/transporteur. L'expérience supplémentaire de la chaîne d'approvisionnement dans d'autres domaines comme l'approvisionnement, l'approvisionnement, la planification de l'approvisionnement et l'entreposage est un atout.
- Connaissances approfondies et expérience opérationnelle dans tous les modes de transport, y compris le fret aérien, le fret maritime, le camion et les services de messagerie.
- Forte mentalité analytique, structurée et axée sur les données.
- Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et de communication, tant orales qu'écrites, pour interagir efficacement avec différentes équipes et parties prenantes
- Compétence en anglais. Les autres langues sont un plus.
- Capacité de travailler et de fournir dans des environnements en évolution, sous une orientation très limitée tout en respectant les délais spécifiés.

Rencontrez l'équipe
L'équipe de transport entrante travaille en étroite collaboration pour atteindre l'excellence dans tout ce que nous faisons, pour s'assurer que les produits de nos fournisseurs aux entrepôts mondiaux sont livrés en temps opportun et de manière optimale. Nous sommes axés sur les données, mais nous sommes aussi orientés vers l'action et nous sommes en mesure de faire plusieurs tâches. Nous établissons et suivons des processus, mais nous contestons continuellement le statu quo et les normes de l'industrie.

Ce que nous offrons
Sur est un endroit qui est centré sur la croissance et le progrès. Nous offrons un environnement conçu pour donner aux gens les outils pour se développer de manière holistique – rester actifs, apprendre, explorer et innover. Notre approche particulière combine une atmosphère de soutien et d'équipe, avec l'accès à des soins personnels pour le bien-être physique et mental, de sorte que chaque personne est dirigée par but.

jobs.title: Lead - Footwear Tooling Engineer
jobs.description:
In short

As Footwear Tooling Engineer you will create groundbreaking concepts and products for high-performance athletes while advancing On’s sustainability goals. Working in a collaborative environment, you’ll shape the future direction of our pinnacle performance product and technologies through Innovation and Design.

You will act as the owner of the bottom unit development for our pinnacle performance product and technologies. You will work in close collaboration with designers and developers here at On Labs in Zurich and our Tooling team in Vietnam to create the highest quality products. From concept creation through prototyping, you will guide the team on bottom unit materials, geometries, and construction from a critical manufacturing, biomechanical performance, and durability viewpoint. You will also be a key player in identifying and creating process improvements for all bottom unit development across the company.

Your mission

- Lead the bottom unit development for On’s performance products

- Provide solutions to design and construction constraints by using your demonstrated knowledge of materials, mold construction and manufacturing

- Evaluate and improve product designs for manufacturability and durability by reviewing 2D/3D CADs, prototypes, and feedback from the testing teams

- Ensure alignment with product specifications and manufacturing capabilities

- Use your understanding of plastics injection molding to advise cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components in the bottom unit

- Collaborate with our Asian counterparts and support mold shop teams on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Assist the development, product management, and design teams with any tooling related questions or issues

- Evaluate current workflows and create process improvements to maximize efficiencies and advance testing

Your story

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related field

- Minimum of 5 years experience within a footwear engineering role working closely with development and production, ideally in a footwear tooling development

- Technical knowledge of various materials, mold construction, and manufacturing processes relevant to footwear; In-depth knowledge of plastics injection molding principles, including advising on cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components

- Experience working with 2D and 3D CADs (Rhino a bonus); proficiency in reviewing and evaluating 2D/3D CADs for manufacturability, durability, and alignment with product specifications

- Experience in 3D modelling and rapid prototyping tools

- Demonstrated experience in project management, costing, and the ability to provide solutions within complex constraints

- Experience working with biomechanical performance principles as they relate to footwear bottom unit design

- Experience working cross-functionally across designers, developers, product management, and testing teams

- Experience collaborating with international manufacturing partners on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Strong communication skills to provide clear guidance and technical support to various stakeholders.

- Excellent time management skills and ability to work with multiple deadlines

- Available to travel to Asia at least 2 times a year

The team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

Come Footwear Tooling Engineer creerete concetti e prodotti innovativi per atleti ad alte prestazioni mentre avanzano gli obiettivi di sostenibilità On.s. Lavorando in un ambiente collaborativo, si.ll plasma la direzione futura del nostro prodotto e delle tecnologie per prestazioni pinnacle attraverso Innovazione e Design.

Lavorerai in stretta collaborazione con designer e sviluppatori di On Labs a Zurigo e con il nostro team Tooling in Vietnam per creare prodotti di altissima qualità. Dalla creazione di concept fino alla prototipazione, guiderai il team su materiali di base, geometrie e costruzioni da un punto di vista critico della produzione, delle prestazioni biomeccaniche e della durata.

Sarete anche un giocatore chiave nell'identificazione e nella creazione di miglioramenti di processo per tutto lo sviluppo delle unità di fondo in tutta l'azienda.

La tua missione

- Guidare lo sviluppo dell'unità inferiore per i prodotti di performance On.s

- Fornire soluzioni per la progettazione e vincoli costruttivi utilizzando la vostra conoscenza dimostrata dei materiali, costruzione di stampi e produzione

- Evaluare e migliorare i progetti di prodotto per la capacità di resistenza e la durata, recensendo CAD 2D/3D, prototipi e feedback dai team di test

- Utilizzare la comprensione dello stampaggio ad iniezione in plastica per consigliare costi, progettazione e capacità di stampaggio dei componenti iniettati nell'unità inferiore

- Assistere lo sviluppo, la gestione dei prodotti e la progettazione team con qualsiasi domanda o problemi relativi strumento

- Evaluare i flussi di lavoro correnti e creare miglioramenti di processo per massimizzare l'efficienza e il test di avanzamento

La tua storia

- Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Disegno Industriale o in un campo correlato

- Esperienza lavorando con i principi di performance biomeccanica in quanto si riferiscono alla progettazione di fondo calzatura

- Esperienza lavorando in modo cross-funzionale tra progettisti, sviluppatori, gestione dei prodotti e team di test

- Esperienza di collaborazione con partner industriali internazionali sulle revisioni degli utensili e sulle problematiche di fabbricazione

- Forte capacità comunicative per fornire orientamenti e supporto tecnico chiari ai vari soggetti interessati.

- Ottima capacità di gestione del tempo e capacità di lavorare con scadenze multiple

- Disponibile per viaggiare in Asia almeno 2 volte all'anno

La squadra

La nostra missione è definire e creare il futuro dello sportswear portando alla luce innovazioni innovative. Aggendo all'avanguardia nella scienza dei materiali, nello sport e nell'ingegneria sviluppiamo prodotti che spingono i confini delle prestazioni e della sostenibilità, mescolandosi in un unico appeal estetico che incarna il DNA di progettazione On.s.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In short

As Footwear Tooling Engineer you will create groundbreaking concepts and products for high-performance athletes while advancing On’s sustainability goals. Working in a collaborative environment, you’ll shape the future direction of our pinnacle performance product and technologies through Innovation and Design.

You will act as the owner of the bottom unit development for our pinnacle performance product and technologies. You will work in close collaboration with designers and developers here at On Labs in Zurich and our Tooling team in Vietnam to create the highest quality products. From concept creation through prototyping, you will guide the team on bottom unit materials, geometries, and construction from a critical manufacturing, biomechanical performance, and durability viewpoint. You will also be a key player in identifying and creating process improvements for all bottom unit development across the company.

Your mission

- Lead the bottom unit development for On’s performance products

- Provide solutions to design and construction constraints by using your demonstrated knowledge of materials, mold construction and manufacturing

- Evaluate and improve product designs for manufacturability and durability by reviewing 2D/3D CADs, prototypes, and feedback from the testing teams

- Ensure alignment with product specifications and manufacturing capabilities

- Use your understanding of plastics injection molding to advise cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components in the bottom unit

- Collaborate with our Asian counterparts and support mold shop teams on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Assist the development, product management, and design teams with any tooling related questions or issues

- Evaluate current workflows and create process improvements to maximize efficiencies and advance testing

Your story

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related field

- Minimum of 5 years experience within a footwear engineering role working closely with development and production, ideally in a footwear tooling development

- Technical knowledge of various materials, mold construction, and manufacturing processes relevant to footwear; In-depth knowledge of plastics injection molding principles, including advising on cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components

- Experience working with 2D and 3D CADs (Rhino a bonus); proficiency in reviewing and evaluating 2D/3D CADs for manufacturability, durability, and alignment with product specifications

- Experience in 3D modelling and rapid prototyping tools

- Demonstrated experience in project management, costing, and the ability to provide solutions within complex constraints

- Experience working with biomechanical performance principles as they relate to footwear bottom unit design

- Experience working cross-functionally across designers, developers, product management, and testing teams

- Experience collaborating with international manufacturing partners on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Strong communication skills to provide clear guidance and technical support to various stakeholders.

- Excellent time management skills and ability to work with multiple deadlines

- Available to travel to Asia at least 2 times a year

The team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.
