jobs.title: Lead - Construction Project Management

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable - Gestion de projet de construction

jobs.description:
In short:

The Lead - Construction Project Manager will report to the Senior Lead - Construction, on the Real Estate and Development team . You will orchestrate the end-to-end delivery of high-end DTC and B2B stores, showrooms and workplaces. Your strategic impact lies in predicting and safeguarding aggressive opening timelines ( Time ) and strictly predicting and controlling budgets ( Cost ) while championing operational excellence during a phase of internal transformation.

Your Mission:

• Lead End-to-End Retail Deployments: Manage the execution of high-end DTC, B2B, SR and WP construction projects from initial planning to handover, ensuring absolute adherence to tight opening schedules and budget.

• Enforce Phase Separation: Maintain a strict boundary between the Design Phase (collaborating with internal designers to secure early sign-offs ) and the Construction Phase to eliminate late-stage changes that impact delivery.

• Manage External PMs & Vendors: Supervise outsourced Project Managers, General Contractors and many other vendors, serving as the ultimate decision-maker for change orders, timelines, and budgets.

• Champion Cost & Time Control: Act as the key financial and schedule forecaster for your projects, evaluating every on-site challenge through the lens of Time and Cost. Quality is given for granted.

• Drive Internal Stakeholder Satisfaction: Partner closely with internal clients to keep them highly engaged, proactively aligned, and enthusiastic about the construction process and improvement.

• Steer Process Optimization: Contribute actively to our ongoing organizational change by structuring scalable workflows, standardized reporting, and post-project feedback loops.

Your Story:

• Proven Retail Construction Track Record: 10+ years of project management experience delivering premium commercial spaces or flagship retail stores (experience in high-end fit-outs is highly valued).

• Mastery of Time & Cost Forecasting: Demonstrated expertise in rigorous scheduling (e.g., Critical Path Method), budget estimation, and proactive risk management under compressed timelines.

• External Vendor Leadership: Strong experience in sourcing, steering, and holding external PM firms, architects, and general contractors accountable to strict KPIs.

• Stakeholder Management & Empathy: Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to educate, influence, and build trusting relationships with demanding internal business clients.

• Structured & Process-Oriented: A logical mindset capable of establishing clear project milestones, "freeze dates" for design, and structured change-management protocols.

• Academic & Language Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, or Project Management. Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of other languages spoken in the EMEA region is highly appreciated.

Your Team:

You will join the EMEA Construction team that deeply values the exceptional work accomplished by its members so far. As we enter a refinement phase, we are committed to giving full credit to those who built this department’s success, while strategically complementing their strength with external professionals of recognized expertise. By blending our solid internal foundation with fresh, high-value industry knowledge, we are ready to elevate our retail expansion to the next level.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve:

Il Lead - Construction Project Manager riferirà al Senior Lead - Construction, sul team Real Estate and Development . Potrai orchestrare la consegna end-to-end di negozi DTC e B2B di fascia alta, showroom e luoghi di lavoro. Il vostro impatto strategico è quello di predire e salvaguardare i tempi di apertura aggressivi (Time ) e di prevedere e controllare rigorosamente i budget (Cost ) pur sostenendo l'eccellenza operativa durante una fase di trasformazione interna.

La vostra missione:

• Lead End-to-End Retail Deployments: Gestire l'esecuzione di progetti di costruzione DTC di fascia alta, B2B, SR e WP dalla pianificazione iniziale alla consegna, assicurando l'assoluta aderenza a orari di apertura stretti e budget.

• Promuovere la Separazione di Fase: Mantenere un rigoroso confine tra la Fase del Design (collaborare con i progettisti interni per garantire i primi sign-off) e la Fase di Costruzione per eliminare i cambiamenti di fine fase che impatto consegna.

• Gestisci PM e fornitori esterni: Supervise outsourced Project Managers, General Contractors e molti altri fornitori, servendo come il decisore finale per gli ordini di cambiamento, le linee temporali e i budget.

• Champion Cost & Time Control: Agite come il programma finanziario e programmatore chiave per i vostri progetti, valutando ogni sfida in loco attraverso l'obiettivo di Time and Cost. La qualità è data per scontato.

• Drive Internal Stakeholder Satisfaction: Partner a stretto contatto con i clienti interni per tenerli altamente impegnati, proattivamente allineati, ed entusiasti circa il processo di costruzione e il miglioramento.

• Ottimizzazione del processo Steer: Contribuisci attivamente al nostro continuo cambiamento organizzativo strutturando flussi di lavoro scalabili, reporting standardizzato e loop di feedback post-progetto.

La tua storia:

• Proven Retail Construction Track Record: 10+ anni di esperienza di gestione del progetto che offre spazi commerciali premium o negozi di punta (l'esperienza in high-end fit-outs è altamente apprezzata).

• Mastery of Time & Cost Forecasting: Competenze dimostrate nella programmazione rigorosa (ad esempio, Metodo del percorso critico), stima del bilancio e gestione del rischio proattivo in termini di tempi compressi.

• Leadership del fornitore esterno: forte esperienza nell'approvvigionamento, nello sterzo e nella tenuta di aziende PM esterne, architetti e imprenditori generali responsabili di rigorosi KPI.

• Stakeholder Management & Empathy: Eccellente capacità di comunicazione con una comprovata capacità di educare, influenzare e costruire relazioni di fiducia con clienti aziendali interni esigenti.

• Strutturato & Process-Orientato: Una mentalità logica in grado di stabilire chiare pietre miliari di progetto, "congelare le date" per il design e i protocolli di gestione dei cambiamenti strutturati.

• Academic & Language Credentials: Laurea in Architettura, Ingegneria Civile o Project Management. È richiesta una fluidità in inglese. La conoscenza delle altre lingue parlate nella regione EMEA è molto apprezzata.

Il vostro team:

Si unirà al team EMEA Construction che valorizza profondamente l'eccezionale lavoro svolto dai suoi membri finora. Entrando in una fase di raffinatezza, ci impegniamo a dare pieno credito a coloro che hanno costruito il successo di questo dipartimento, pur integrando strategicamente la loro forza con professionisti esterni di competenza riconosciuta. Combinando la nostra solida base interna con una conoscenza del settore fresco e ad alto valore, siamo pronti ad elevare la nostra espansione al livello successivo.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurzum:

Der Lead - Construction Project Manager wird dem Senior Lead - Construction über das Immobilien- und Entwicklungsteam berichten. Sie orchestrieren die End-to-End-Lieferung von hochwertigen DTC- und B2B-Stores, Showrooms und Arbeitsplätzen. Ihre strategischen Auswirkungen liegen in der Vorhersage und Sicherung aggressiver Öffnungszeiten (Zeit) und der strikten Vorhersage und Kontrolle von Budgets (Kosten), während Sie sich während einer Phase der internen Transformation für operative Exzellenz einsetzen.

Ihre Mission:

• Führen Sie End-to-End-Einführungen im Einzelhandel: Verwalten Sie die Ausführung von High-End-DTC-, B2B-, SR- und WP-Bauprojekten von der Erstplanung bis zur Übergabe und stellen Sie die absolute Einhaltung der engen Öffnungspläne und des Budgets sicher.

• Phasentrennung durchsetzen: Bewahren Sie eine strikte Grenze zwischen der Entwurfsphase (Zusammenarbeit mit internen Designern, um frühzeitige Abmeldungen zu sichern) und der Bauphase auf, um späte Änderungen zu vermeiden, die sich auf die Lieferung auswirken.

• Verwalten Sie externe PMs und Anbieter: Beaufsichtigen Sie ausgelagerte Projektmanager, Generalunternehmer und viele andere Anbieter und sind Sie der ultimative Entscheidungsträger für Änderungsaufträge, Zeitpläne und Budgets.

• Champion Cost & Time Control: Handeln Sie als der wichtigste Finanz- und Terminprognosegeber für Ihre Projekte und bewerten Sie jede Herausforderung vor Ort anhand von Zeit und Kosten. Qualität ist selbstverständlich.

• Förderung der internen Stakeholder-Zufriedenheit: Enge Partnerschaft mit internen Kunden, um sie hoch engagiert, proaktiv ausgerichtet und vom Bauprozess und der Verbesserung begeistert zu halten.

• Steuerungsprozessoptimierung: Tragen Sie aktiv zu unserem laufenden organisatorischen Wandel bei, indem Sie skalierbare Workflows, standardisiertes Reporting und Post-Projekt-Feedbackschleifen strukturieren.

Deine Geschichte:

• Proven Retail Construction Track Record: 10+ Jahre Projektmanagement-Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung von Premium-Geschäftsräumen oder Flaggschiff-Einzelhandelsgeschäften (Erfahrung in High-End-Ausstattungen wird sehr geschätzt).

• Beherrschung der Zeit- und Kostenprognose: Nachgewiesene Expertise in der strengen Planung (z. B. Critical Path-Methode), Budgetschätzung und proaktives Risikomanagement unter komprimierten Zeitplänen.

• Externe Vendor-Führung: Starke Erfahrung in der Beschaffung, Steuerung und Bindung externer PM-Firmen, Architekten und Generalunternehmer, die strengen KPIs unterliegen.

• Stakeholder Management & Empathy: Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, zu erziehen, zu beeinflussen und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen mit anspruchsvollen internen Geschäftskunden aufzubauen.

• Strukturiert und prozessorientiert: Eine logische Denkweise, die in der Lage ist, klare Projektmeilensteine, "Einfrierungsdaten" für das Design und strukturierte Change-Management-Protokolle festzulegen.

• Academic & Language Credentials: Bachelor-Abschluss in Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen oder Projektmanagement. Fließend in Englisch ist erforderlich. Kenntnisse anderer Sprachen, die in der EMEA-Region gesprochen werden, werden sehr geschätzt.

Ihr Team:

Sie werden dem EMEA Construction Team beitreten, das die außergewöhnliche Arbeit seiner Mitglieder bisher sehr schätzt. Da wir in eine Verfeinerungsphase eintreten, sind wir bestrebt, denjenigen, die den Erfolg dieser Abteilung aufgebaut haben, volle Anerkennung zu zollen und gleichzeitig ihre Stärke strategisch mit externen Fachleuten mit anerkanntem Fachwissen zu ergänzen. Indem wir unser solides internes Fundament mit frischem, hochwertigem Branchenwissen verbinden, sind wir bereit, unsere Einzelhandelsexpansion auf die nächste Stufe zu heben.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref:

Le responsable - Chef de projet de construction relèvera du responsable principal - Construction, de l'équipe de l'immobilier et du développement. Vous orchestrerez la livraison de bout en bout des magasins haut de gamme DTC et B2B, des showrooms et des lieux de travail. Votre impact stratégique réside dans la prédiction et la sauvegarde de calendriers d'ouverture agressifs (temps ) et dans la prévision et le contrôle rigoureux des budgets ( coût ) tout en défendant l'excellence opérationnelle pendant une phase de transformation interne.

Votre mission :

• Diriger les déploiements de bout en bout de détail : Gérer l'exécution des projets de construction haut de gamme DTC, B2B, SR et WP de la planification initiale au transfert, en assurant le respect absolu des calendriers d'ouverture serrés et du budget.

• Séparation de la phase d'application : Maintenir une limite stricte entre la phase de conception (en collaboration avec les concepteurs internes pour obtenir des approbations anticipées) et la phase de construction afin d'éliminer les changements tardifs qui ont une incidence sur la prestation.

• Gérer les PG externes et les fournisseurs : Superviser les gestionnaires de projet sous-traités, les entrepreneurs généraux et de nombreux autres fournisseurs, servant de décideur ultime pour les commandes de changement, les échéanciers et les budgets.

• Champion Contrôle des coûts et du temps : agissez comme le principal prévisionniste financier et de calendrier pour vos projets, en évaluant chaque défi sur place à travers la lentille du temps et des coûts. La qualité est donnée pour acquis.

• Favoriser la satisfaction des intervenants internes : S'associer étroitement avec les clients internes pour les maintenir très engagés, en harmonie proactive et enthousiastes au sujet du processus de construction et de l'amélioration.

• Optimisation du processus de pilotage : Contribuer activement à notre changement organisationnel en structurant les flux de travail évolutifs, les rapports normalisés et les boucles de rétroaction post-projet.

Votre histoire :

• Expérience éprouvée de la construction au détail : plus de 10 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet en offrant des espaces commerciaux ou des magasins de détail phares (l'expérience en aménagement haut de gamme est très appréciée).

• Maîtrise du temps et des prévisions de coûts : expertise démontrée en planification rigoureuse (p. ex., méthode de cheminement critique), estimation budgétaire et gestion proactive des risques dans des délais serrés.

• Leadership des fournisseurs externes : Forte expérience dans l'approvisionnement, la direction et la tenue de cabinets de PM externes, d'architectes et d'entrepreneurs généraux responsables devant des ICR stricts.

• Gestion des intervenants et empathie : Excellentes compétences en communication avec une capacité éprouvée d'éduquer, d'influencer et d'établir des relations de confiance avec des clients opérationnels internes exigeants.

• Structured & Process-Oriented: Un état d'esprit logique capable d'établir des étapes claires du projet, des « dates de gel » pour la conception et des protocoles structurés de gestion du changement.

• Baccalauréat en architecture, génie civil ou gestion de projet. La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise. La connaissance des autres langues parlées dans la région de l'EMEA est très appréciée.

Votre équipe :

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe de construction de l'EMEA qui apprécie profondément le travail exceptionnel accompli jusqu'à présent par ses membres. À mesure que nous entrons dans une phase de raffinement, nous nous engageons à rendre pleinement hommage à ceux qui ont construit ce département, tout en complétant stratégiquement leur force par des professionnels externes d'expertise reconnue. En mélangeant notre solide fondation interne avec des connaissances industrielles fraîches et de grande valeur, nous sommes prêts à élever notre expansion au niveau supérieur.

jobs.title: Lead - Commercialization Engineer

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de Projet - Ingénieur en Commercialisation

jobs.description:
In short:

As a Lead, Innovation commercialization engineer, you will be a driving force at the forefront of On's scale of product evolution. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy to lead complex projects, challenge conventions, and champion innovative approaches that define the future of footwear. This role requires you to master technical complexity, manage key stakeholder relationships, and translate visionary concepts into scalable, performance-driven products.

Your Mission:

• As a leader within the team, you will independently manage multiple high-impact footwear development projects from confirmation to production, defining methods and procedures for new assignments and potentially supervising other team members. As a senior contributor, you will leverage your expertise to guide and influence both management and your team.

• You will spearhead the end-to-end commercialization process, leveraging your expert knowledge of manufacturing processes, fit, material properties, mold and process manufacturing. Your strong root-cause analysis mindset will be crucial in troubleshooting significant and unique issues related to tooling, molding, assembly, fit, and wear.

• As the central hub for On’s key manufacturing regions, you will act as a critical liaison between On inline development and production teams, working closely with strategic vendors to ensure product intent is maintained while meeting commercial and operational requirements. You will engineer products for efficient manufacturability, lowest cost, and highest quality and performance.

• You will serve as a key influencer and central communication hub, managing expectations and negotiating effectively with diverse internal teams and major external T1/T2 partners and sourcing teams across regions.

• Collaborating with computational designers, you will work with upper patterns and tooling construction adjustments to enhance fit, durability, and ensure scalable manufacturing. You will be responsible for full size run grading, technical manufacturing operation manuals, initial production trial, ERP system update, scalability sign off, among others.

• You will own the documentation of complex tooling and upper-related issues, defining and communicating clear correction actions to all stakeholders for manufacturing guidelines.

Your Story:

• 8+ years of progressive experience in the footwear industry, with a significant focus on innovation and bringing new technologies to market.

• Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Engineering, Material Science, or another relevant technical field.

• 2D and 3D, computational design and algorithmic capabilities are a plus.

• Proven ability to not only lead the scaling of new technologies but also to assess their commercial viability and factory readiness.

• Expert-level knowledge of advanced footwear manufacturing processes, including robotics, automation, tooling, molding, injecting, welding, lasting, and assembly. You understand factory capabilities, tolerances, and limitations and know how to engineer for scalable replication.

• A natural technical curiosity and a robust, root-cause analysis approach to problem-solving.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to confidently present to senior management and external partners.

• A demonstrated ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, navigating ambiguity and making independent judgments on complex and significant issues.

• Experience in mentoring junior team members or supervising project activities is a strong plus.

• Ability to travel up to 15-20% of the time.

Your Team:

On's Innovation team is an agile, interdisciplinary group of footwear creation, advanced manufacturing, and future of sport experts, driving On's future innovations and athlete-informed technologies that set On footwear apart.

We challenge the status quo and push boundaries to pioneer footwear innovation. As a member of the On Innovation Team, you will think outside the box and bring new, innovative ideas to life.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

In breve:

Come ingegnere leader, Innovation Commercialization, sarete una forza trainante all'avanguardia nell'evoluzione dei prodotti di On. Opererete con un alto grado di autonomia per condurre progetti complessi, sfidare convenzioni e sostenere approcci innovativi che definiscono il futuro delle calzature. Questo ruolo richiede di padroneggiare la complessità tecnica, gestire le relazioni chiave degli stakeholder e tradurre concetti visionari in prodotti a scala mobile e basati sulle prestazioni.

La tua missione

- Come leader all'interno del team, gestirai in modo indipendente diversi progetti di sviluppo di calzature ad alto impatto dalla conferma alla produzione, definendo metodi e procedure per nuove assegnazioni e potenzialmente supervisionando altri membri del team. Come collaboratore senior, potrai sfruttare la tua esperienza per guidare e influenzare sia la gestione che il tuo team.

- Avrete la punta del processo di commercializzazione end-to-end, sfruttando la vostra conoscenza esperto di processi di produzione, fit, proprietà dei materiali, muffa e produzione di processo. La vostra forte mentalità di analisi della causa-radice sarà cruciale nella risoluzione dei problemi significativi e unici relativi a utensili, stampaggio, assemblaggio, fit, e usura.

- Come hub centrale per le principali regioni di produzione On.s, agirai come collegamento critico tra team di sviluppo e produzione Online, lavorando a stretto contatto con fornitori strategici per garantire che l'intento del prodotto sia mantenuto, rispettando i requisiti commerciali e operativi. Ingegnererà prodotti per una efficiente capacità di costruzione, costi più bassi e la massima qualità e prestazioni.

- Servirete come un centro di comunicazione centrale e influencer chiave, la gestione delle aspettative e negoziare efficacemente con diversi team interni e con i principali partner esterni T1/T2 e le squadre di approvvigionamento in tutte le regioni.

- Diramando con progettisti computazionali, lavorerete con modelli superiori e regolazioni di costruzione per migliorare la vestibilità, la durata e garantire la produzione di scalabili. Sarete responsabili per la classificazione di funzionamento full size, manuali di funzionamento tecnico, prova di produzione iniziale, aggiornamento del sistema ERP, registrazione della scalabilità, tra gli altri.

- La documentazione relativa a strumenti complessi e questioni di livello superiore sarà vostra, definendo e comunicando a tutti gli stakeholder azioni di correzione chiare per le linee guida di fabbricazione.

La tua storia

- 8+ anni di esperienza progressista nel settore calzaturiero, con un'attenzione significativa all'innovazione e all'introduzione sul mercato di nuove tecnologie.

- Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Scienze Materiali o un altro campo tecnico rilevante.

- 2D e 3D, progettazione computazionale e capacità algoritmiche sono un plus.

- la capacità di condurre non solo la scalatura delle nuove tecnologie, ma anche la loro redditività commerciale e la loro disponibilità in fabbrica.

- Conoscenza a livello di esperti dei processi di produzione di calzature avanzate, tra cui robotica, automazione, utensili, stampaggio, iniezione, saldatura, durata e montaggio. Comprendete le capacità, le tolleranze e le limitazioni di fabbrica e sapete come progettare la replicabilità a scala mobile.

- Una curiosità tecnica naturale e un approccio robusto e robusto all'analisi delle cause della risoluzione dei problemi.

- Comunicazione, negoziazione e capacità di influenza eccezionali, con la capacità di presentarsi con fiducia ai dirigenti e ai partner esterni.

- Una capacità dimostrata di lavorare con un alto grado di autonomia, navigando nell'ambiguità e pronunciando giudizi indipendenti su questioni complesse e significative.

- L'esperienza in mentoring giovani membri del team o supervisione attività del progetto è un vantaggio forte.

- Possibilità di viaggiare fino al 15-20% del tempo.

La tua squadra

On's Innovation team è un gruppo interdisciplinare di produttori di calzature, produttori avanzati e futuri esperti sportivi, che guidano le innovazioni future di On e tecnologie athlete-informate che separano le calzature.

Sfidiamo lo status quo e spiniamo i confini verso l'innovazione pioniere delle calzature. Come membro del team On Innovation, penserete fuori dagli schemi e porterete alla vita nuove idee innovative.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Kurz gesagt:

Als Lead, Innovations-Commanderization-Ingenieur, werden Sie eine treibende Kraft an der Spitze der On-Skala der Produktentwicklung. Sie werden mit einem hohen Grad an Autonomie zu arbeiten, um komplexe Projekte zu führen, Herausforderung Konventionen, und die Innovationsansätze, die die Zukunft der Schuhe definieren. Diese Rolle erfordert es, technische Komplexität zu meistern, Management Schlüssel Stakeholder-Beziehungen und übersetzen visionäre Konzepte in skalierbare, leistungsorientierte Produkte.

Ihre Mission

- Als Führungskraft im Team verwalten Sie unabhängig von der Bestätigung bis zur Produktion mehrere hochwirksame Schuhentwicklungsprojekte, definieren Methoden und Verfahren für neue Aufgaben und überwachen möglicherweise andere Teammitglieder. Als Senior-Beitrager nutzen Sie Ihre Expertise, um das Management und Ihr Team zu leiten und zu beeinflussen.

- Sie werden die Speerspitze der End-to-End-Commancialization Prozess, die Nutzung Ihrer Expertenwissen über Herstellungsverfahren, Passform, Materialeigenschaften, Form-und Prozess-Fertigung. Ihre starke Wurzel-Ursache Analyse Mindset wird entscheidend bei der Fehlersuche wichtige und einzigartige Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Werkzeugen, Formgebung, Montage, Passform und Verschleiß.

- Als zentrale Drehscheibe für On,s wichtige Produktionsregionen, werden Sie als eine kritische Verbindung zwischen On Inline Entwicklungs- und Produktionsteams, eng mit strategischen Anbietern zu arbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass Produktabsichten beibehalten werden, während kommerzielle und betriebliche Anforderungen erfüllt werden. Sie werden Produkte für effiziente Manufakturierbarkeit, niedrigste Kosten und höchste Qualität und Leistung zu konstruieren.

- Sie werden als zentrales Kommunikationszentrum und Influencer fungieren, um Erwartungen zu managen und mit verschiedenen internen Teams und wichtigen externen T1/T2-Partnern und Teams in allen Regionen effektiv zu verhandeln.

- In Zusammenarbeit mit Computerdesignern arbeiten Sie mit oberen Mustern und Werkzeugbau-Anpassungen, um die Passform, Haltbarkeit und eine skalierbare Fertigung zu verbessern. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Full-Size-Lauf-Sortierung, technische Fertigung Betriebsanleitungen, erste Produktionsprobe, ERP-System-Update, Skalierbarkeitssign off, unter anderem.

- Sie werden die Dokumentation komplexer Werkzeuge und übergeordneter Themen besitzen, indem Sie klare Korrekturmaßnahmen für die Herstellungsrichtlinien an alle Beteiligten definieren und kommunizieren.

Ihre Geschichte

- 8+ Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der Schuhindustrie, mit einem bedeutenden Fokus auf Innovation und die Markteinführung neuer Technologien.

- Bachelor, Master oder Master in Ingenieurwesen, Materialwissenschaft oder einem anderen relevanten technischen Bereich.

- 2D und 3D, Rechendesign und algorithmische Fähigkeiten sind ein Plus.

- Bewährte Fähigkeit, nicht nur die Skalierung neuer Technologien zu führen, sondern auch ihre wirtschaftliche Lebensfähigkeit und Fabrikbereitschaft zu bewerten.

- Expertenwissen über fortgeschrittene Schuhherstellungsprozesse, einschließlich Robotik, Automatisierung, Werkzeugbau, Formgebung, Spritzguss, Schweißen, Dauer- und Montage. Sie verstehen die Fähigkeiten, Toleranzen und Grenzen der Fabrik und wissen, wie Sie für skalierbare Replikationen zu entwickeln sind.

- Eine natürliche technische Neugier und ein robuster, wurzel-herausragender Ansatz zur Problemlösung.

- Außergewöhnliche Kommunikation, Verhandlungen und Einflussnahme von Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Senior Management und externen Partnern vertrauensvoll zu präsentieren.

- eine nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, mit einem hohen Grad an Autonomie zu arbeiten, Unklarheiten zu navigieren und unabhängige Urteile in komplexen und wichtigen Fragen zu treffen.

- Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Nachwuchsteammitgliedern oder der Überwachung von Projektaktivitäten ist ein starkes Plus.

- Fähigkeit, bis zu 15-20% der Zeit zu reisen.

Ihr Team

On's Innovation Team ist eine agile, interdisziplinäre Gruppe von Schuhkreation, fortschrittliche Fertigung und Zukunft von Sportexperten, die On's zukünftige Innovationen und athletic-informed Technologien, die auf Schuhe auseinander.

Wir fordern den Status quo heraus und schieben Grenzen für Pionier-Innovationen im Schuhwerk. Als Mitglied des On Innovation Teams werden Sie über den Tellerrand hinaus denken und neue, innovative Ideen zum Leben erwecken.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

En bref:

En tant que chef de file, ingénieur en commercialisation de l'innovation, vous serez un moteur de l'évolution des produits à l'échelle d'On. Vous travaillerez avec une grande autonomie pour diriger des projets complexes, des conventions de challenge et des approches innovantes qui définissent l'avenir de la chaussure. Ce rôle vous oblige à maîtriser la complexité technique, gérer les relations avec les intervenants clés et traduire des concepts visionnaires en produits évolutifs et axés sur la performance.

Votre mission

- En tant que leader au sein de l'équipe, vous gérerez de façon indépendante plusieurs projets de développement de chaussures à impact élevé, de la confirmation à la production, en définissant les méthodes et les procédures pour les nouvelles affectations et en supervisant éventuellement d'autres membres de l'équipe.

- Vous serez le fer de lance du processus de commercialisation de bout en bout, en tirant parti de votre connaissance experte des processus de fabrication, de l'ajustement, des propriétés des matériaux, des moules et de la fabrication de processus.

- En tant que centre central pour les régions manufacturières clés d'On, vous agirez comme une liaison critique entre les équipes de développement et de production Online, en travaillant étroitement avec les fournisseurs stratégiques pour assurer le maintien de l'intention du produit tout en répondant aux exigences commerciales et opérationnelles.

- Vous serez un pôle central de communication et de polarisation, gérerez les attentes et négocierez efficacement avec diverses équipes internes et les principaux partenaires externes T1/T2 et équipes de sourcing dans toutes les régions.

- En collaboration avec les concepteurs de calcul, vous travaillerez avec des modèles supérieurs et des ajustements de construction d'outillage pour améliorer l'ajustement, la durabilité et assurer la fabrication évolutive. Vous serez responsable du classement complet, des manuels techniques de fabrication, de l'essai de production initial, de la mise à jour du système ERP, de l'approbation de l'évolutivité, entre autres.

- Vous posséderez la documentation d'outils complexes et de questions supérieures, en définissant et en communiquant des mesures de correction claires à tous les intervenants pour les lignes directrices de fabrication.

Votre histoire

- 8 ans et plus d'expérience progressive dans l'industrie de la chaussure, avec un accent important sur l'innovation et l'introduction de nouvelles technologies sur le marché.

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en ingénierie, sciences des matériaux ou autre domaine technique pertinent.

- 2D et 3D, conception informatique et capacités algorithmiques sont un plus.

- Être en mesure non seulement de diriger l'échelle des nouvelles technologies, mais aussi d'évaluer leur viabilité commerciale et leur capacité d'usine.

- Connaissances spécialisées des processus de fabrication de chaussures avancés, y compris la robotique, l'automatisation, l'outillage, le moulage, l'injection, le soudage, la durabilité et l'assemblage.

- Une curiosité technique naturelle et une approche solide et basée sur l'analyse de la cause profonde pour résoudre les problèmes.

- Communication, négociation et compétences exceptionnelles, avec la capacité de présenter en toute confiance aux cadres supérieurs et aux partenaires externes.

- Une capacité démontrée de travailler avec une grande autonomie, de naviguer dans l'ambiguïté et de faire des jugements indépendants sur des questions complexes et importantes.

- L'expérience en mentorat des membres de l'équipe junior ou en supervision des activités de projet est un atout.

- Capacité de voyager jusqu'à 15-20 % du temps.

Votre équipe

L'équipe Innovation d'On est un groupe de création de chaussures, de fabrication avancée et d'avenir des experts du sport, qui pilote les innovations futures d'On et les technologies adaptées aux athlètes qui mettent les chaussures à part.

Nous défions le statu quo et repoussons les frontières pour faire de l'innovation dans le domaine de la chaussure un pionnier. En tant que membre de l'équipe On Innovation, vous réfléchirez en dehors de la boîte et vous donnerez vie à de nouvelles idées novatrices.

jobs.title: Lead - Apparel Testing
jobs.description:
In short

Product Testing is the voice of the athlete and the consumer at On. We ensure every product delivers a premium, high-performance experience by combining scientific rigor with real-world insight.

As Apparel and Accessories Testing Lead, you will be responsible for validating products from development through to market, focusing on specialized, high performance sport categories. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and act as a key partner across Design, Development, Materials, and Strategy to ensure excellence in the wearing experience including comfort, durability, and performance.

Your mission

Command the Validation Strategy: Define and execute rigorous testing strategies across durability, comfort, and performance, taking charge of specialized testing programs. You will identify testing requirements based on product briefs and target consumers, confidently owning the end-to-end testing process.

Uncover the Truth in Data: Lead qualitative and quantitative apparel and accessories testing, perception studies, and real-world validation to ensure our products reflect authentic athlete and consumer needs. Integrate consumer insights, scientific expertise, and performance analysis into standardized, evidence-based product evaluations.

Drive Confident Decisions: Translate complex testing results into powerful insights that enable confident decision-making and elevate product excellence across the organization. You will analyze performance and durability data, including behavior and attitudinal insights, developing clear reports for project stakeholders.

Influence Product Creation: Conduct hands-on performance testing, directly presenting key findings and improvement recommendations to critical stakeholders. Deliver benchmarking and competitor insights to spot opportunities for true innovation and product differentiation in the global sports arena.

Build the Testing Ecosystem: Establish highly efficient testing processes, timelines, and feedback loops aligned seamlessly with Product Creation calendars. You will actively build and maintain a dynamic tester network of agile, high-performance athletes that supports both everyday testing needs and urgent project timelines. Set up high-energy testing events and initiatives to drive deep engagement within the testing community.

Elevate Operations: Work seamlessly with testing systems and databases to ensure accurate, high-quality data and optimized reporting flows. As a leader, you will contribute significantly to team goals, process improvements, and the continuous evolution of our testing methodologies.

Your story

• A strategic thinker and natural leader with a proven track record of managing complex projects or product validation cycles from concept to market.

• You possess a deep understanding of specialized, high-performance sports apparel and accessories, and know how to balance scientific testing rigor with real-world, human-centric feedback.

• You are an exceptional communicator who can translate dense data and testing metrics into clear, actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams

• You are highly organized and capable of building out robust tester networks, establishing efficient processes, and managing global testing logistics.

• You have 7+ years of experience in a field focused on the human experience with a product or service. We are excited to hear from candidates from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to:

• Apparel Product Testing or Development

• User Experience Research (UXR)

• Biomechanics or Kinesiology

• Materials Science or Textile Engineering

• Ergonomics or Human Factors

• Sports Marketing or Athlete Management

• High-Performance Coaching

• You are willing to travel globally and have the flexibility to work outside of typical hours to align with athlete schedules and events.

• A clear communicator in English, both verbal and written.

Your Team

You'll be a leader in a global team fueled by a culture of relentless discovery. We test and validate our product promises, transforming athlete feedback and scientific data into market-leading performance. While our creation partners work to make products great, our mission is to prove they're great. Based in Zurich, our team of Footwear, Apparel & Accessories, and Lab experts is the ultimate destination for individuals dedicated to enhancing the consumer experience.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

Test di prodotto è la voce dell'atleta e il consumatore a On. Ci assicuriamo che ogni prodotto offre un'esperienza di alta qualità, combinando rigor scientifico con la visione del mondo reale.

Come il Lead di Testing di Rarel e il Lead di Accessori, sarete responsabili della convalida dei prodotti dallo sviluppo al mercato, concentrandosi su categorie sportive specializzate e ad alte prestazioni. Lavorerete in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce e agirete come partner chiave in tutto il Design, Sviluppo, Materiali e Strategia per garantire l'eccellenza nell'esperienza di indossare tra cui comfort, durata e prestazioni.

La tua missione

Comando della strategia di convalida: Definire ed eseguire strategie di test rigorose attraverso la durata, il comfort e le prestazioni, prendendosi cura di programmi di test specializzati. Identificherete i requisiti di test basati su slip di prodotto e consumatori target, con fiducia possedere il processo di test end-to-end.

Scopri la Verità nei Dati: Lead qualitativo e quantitativo abbigliamento e accessori testing, studi di percezione, e convalida reale mondo per garantire i nostri prodotti riflettono autentiche esigenze di atleta e consumatori. Integrate intuizioni dei consumatori, competenze scientifiche, e analisi delle prestazioni in valutazioni standard, basate su prove prodotto.

Decisioni di chi ha la competenza: Tradurre risultati di test complessi in potenti intuizioni che consentono di prendere decisioni sicure e l'eccellenza di prodotti di 124 in tutta l'organizzazione. Analizzare le prestazioni e i dati di durata, tra cui behavior e intuizioni attitudinali, sviluppando report chiari per gli stakeholder del progetto.

Influenza Creazione di prodotti: Condurre test pratici delle prestazioni, presentando direttamente i risultati chiave e le raccomandazioni di miglioramento ai soggetti critici. Offrire benchmarking e informazioni sui concorrenti per individuare opportunità di vera innovazione e differenziazione dei prodotti nell'arena sportiva globale.

Costruisci l'Ecosistema di Testing: Stabilisci processi di test altamente efficienti, linee temporali e cicli di feedback allineati senza problemi con i calendari di creazione del prodotto. Costruirai e manterai attivamente una rete di tester dinamici di atleti agili, ad alte prestazioni che supportano sia le esigenze di test quotidiani che le scadenze urgenti dei progetti.

Operazioni di Elevate: Lavorate senza problemi con sistemi di testing e database per garantire dati accurati e di alta qualità e flussi di reporting ottimizzati. Come leader, contribuirete in modo significativo agli obiettivi del team, ai miglioramenti dei processi e alla continua evoluzione delle nostre metodologie di testing.

La tua storia

• Un pensatore strategico e leader naturale con un comprovata esperienza nella gestione di progetti complessi o cicli di validazione dei prodotti dal concetto al mercato.

• Si dispone di una profonda comprensione di abbigliamento sportivo specializzato e ad alte prestazioni e di accessori, e sapere bilanciare i test scientifici rigor con reale mondo, umano-centric feedback.

descriptionByLocale.en:
In short

Product Testing is the voice of the athlete and the consumer at On. We ensure every product delivers a premium, high-performance experience by combining scientific rigor with real-world insight.

As Apparel and Accessories Testing Lead, you will be responsible for validating products from development through to market, focusing on specialized, high performance sport categories. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and act as a key partner across Design, Development, Materials, and Strategy to ensure excellence in the wearing experience including comfort, durability, and performance.

Your mission

Command the Validation Strategy: Define and execute rigorous testing strategies across durability, comfort, and performance, taking charge of specialized testing programs. You will identify testing requirements based on product briefs and target consumers, confidently owning the end-to-end testing process.

Uncover the Truth in Data: Lead qualitative and quantitative apparel and accessories testing, perception studies, and real-world validation to ensure our products reflect authentic athlete and consumer needs. Integrate consumer insights, scientific expertise, and performance analysis into standardized, evidence-based product evaluations.

Drive Confident Decisions: Translate complex testing results into powerful insights that enable confident decision-making and elevate product excellence across the organization. You will analyze performance and durability data, including behavior and attitudinal insights, developing clear reports for project stakeholders.

Influence Product Creation: Conduct hands-on performance testing, directly presenting key findings and improvement recommendations to critical stakeholders. Deliver benchmarking and competitor insights to spot opportunities for true innovation and product differentiation in the global sports arena.

Build the Testing Ecosystem: Establish highly efficient testing processes, timelines, and feedback loops aligned seamlessly with Product Creation calendars. You will actively build and maintain a dynamic tester network of agile, high-performance athletes that supports both everyday testing needs and urgent project timelines. Set up high-energy testing events and initiatives to drive deep engagement within the testing community.

Elevate Operations: Work seamlessly with testing systems and databases to ensure accurate, high-quality data and optimized reporting flows. As a leader, you will contribute significantly to team goals, process improvements, and the continuous evolution of our testing methodologies.

Your story

• A strategic thinker and natural leader with a proven track record of managing complex projects or product validation cycles from concept to market.

• You possess a deep understanding of specialized, high-performance sports apparel and accessories, and know how to balance scientific testing rigor with real-world, human-centric feedback.

• You are an exceptional communicator who can translate dense data and testing metrics into clear, actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams

• You are highly organized and capable of building out robust tester networks, establishing efficient processes, and managing global testing logistics.

• You have 7+ years of experience in a field focused on the human experience with a product or service. We are excited to hear from candidates from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to:

• Apparel Product Testing or Development

• User Experience Research (UXR)

• Biomechanics or Kinesiology

• Materials Science or Textile Engineering

• Ergonomics or Human Factors

• Sports Marketing or Athlete Management

• High-Performance Coaching

• You are willing to travel globally and have the flexibility to work outside of typical hours to align with athlete schedules and events.

• A clear communicator in English, both verbal and written.

Your Team

You'll be a leader in a global team fueled by a culture of relentless discovery. We test and validate our product promises, transforming athlete feedback and scientific data into market-leading performance. While our creation partners work to make products great, our mission is to prove they're great. Based in Zurich, our team of Footwear, Apparel & Accessories, and Lab experts is the ultimate destination for individuals dedicated to enhancing the consumer experience.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz gefasst

Produktprüfungen sind die Stimme des Sportlers und des Verbrauchers bei On. Wir sorgen dafür, dass jedes Produkt durch die Kombination von wissenschaftlicher Strenge mit realer Einsicht ein Premium- und Leistungserlebnis bietet.

Als Apparel und Zubehör Testing Lead sind Sie für die Validierung von Produkten von der Entwicklung bis zum Markt verantwortlich, wobei Sie sich auf spezialisierte Hochleistungssportkategorien konzentrieren. Sie arbeiten in einem schnelllebigen, kollaborativen Umfeld und agieren als wichtiger Partner in den Bereichen Design, Entwicklung, Materialien und Strategie, um herausragende Leistungen im Tragekomfort, einschließlich Haltbarkeit und Leistung zu gewährleisten.

Ihre Mission

Befehl der Validierungsstrategie: Definieren und führen Sie strenge Teststrategien über Haltbarkeit, Komfort und Leistung aus, wobei Sie spezielle Testprogramme übernehmen. Sie identifizieren Testanforderungen basierend auf Produktslips und Zielkunden, die selbstbewusst den End-to-End-Testprozess besitzen.

Entdecken Sie die Wahrheit in Daten: Führen Sie qualitative und quantitative Bekleidung und Zubehör Tests, Wahrnehmungsstudien und Real-Welt-Validierung, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Produkte authentische Sportler und Verbraucher Bedürfnisse. Integrieren Verbraucher Einblicke, wissenschaftliche Expertise und Leistungsanalyse in standardisierte, evidenzbasierte Produktbewertungen.

Führen Sie vertrauensvolle Entscheidungen: Übersetzen Sie komplexe Testergebnisse in leistungsstarke Erkenntnisse, die eine vertrauensvolle Entscheidungsfindung ermöglichen und die Produktexzellenz in der gesamten Organisation erhöhen. Sie analysieren Leistungs- und Haltbarkeitsdaten, einschließlich Verhalten und attitudinale Erkenntnisse, und erstellen klare Berichte für Projektakteure.

Einfluss Produkterstellung: Führen Sie praktische Leistungstests durch, die wichtige Erkenntnisse und Verbesserungsempfehlungen direkt an kritische Stakeholder weitergeben. Ermöglichen Sie Benchmarking und Wettbewerbseinblicke, um Chancen für echte Innovation und Produktdifferenzierung in der globalen Sportarena zu erkennen.

Build the Testing Ecosystem: Etablieren Sie hocheffiziente Testprozesse, Zeitlinien und Feedback-Schleifen, die nahtlos mit den Produkterstellungskalendern abgestimmt sind. Sie bauen und pflegen aktiv ein dynamisches Tester-Netzwerk von agilen, leistungsstarken Athleten, die sowohl den täglichen Testbedarf als auch die dringenden Projekt-Zeitlinien unterstützen.

Elevate Operations: Arbeiten Sie nahtlos mit Testsystemen und Datenbanken, um genaue, qualitativ hochwertige Daten und optimierte Reporting-Flows zu gewährleisten. Als Marktführer tragen Sie maßgeblich zu Teamzielen, Prozessverbesserungen und der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Testmethoden bei.

Ihre Geschichte

• Ein strategischer Denker und natürlicher Marktführer mit einer bewährten Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung komplexer Projekte oder Produktvalidierungszyklen von Konzept zu Markt.

• Sie verfügen über ein tiefes Verständnis von spezialisierten, leistungsstarken Sportbekleidung und Zubehör und wissen, wie man wissenschaftliche Teststarre mit realen, menschenzentrierten Feedbacks ausgleicht.

• Sie sind ein außergewöhnlicher Kommunikator, der dichte Daten übersetzen und Metriken in klare, umsetzbare Empfehlungen an funktionsübergreifende Teams testen kann.

• Sie sind hoch organisiert und in der Lage, robuste Testernetzwerke aufzubauen, effiziente Prozesse zu etablieren und die globale Testlogistik zu verwalten.

• Sie haben 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in einem Bereich, der sich auf die menschliche Erfahrung mit einem Produkt oder einer Dienstleistung konzentriert. Wir freuen uns, von Kandidaten aus verschiedenen Hintergründen zu hören, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf:

• Produktprüfung oder Entwicklung von Bekleidung

• User Experience Research (UXR)

• Biomechanik oder Kinesiologie

• Materialwissenschaft oder Textiltechnik

• Ergonomie oder menschliche Faktoren

• Sportmarketing oder Athletenmanagement

• Leistungsorientiertes Coaching

• Sie sind bereit, global zu reisen und haben die Flexibilität, außerhalb der typischen Stunden zu arbeiten, um sich an die Zeiten und Ereignisse der Athleten anzupassen.

• Ein klarer Kommunikator in englischer Sprache, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.

Ihr Team

Sie werden ein führendes Team sein, das von einer Kultur der unerbittlichen Entdeckung angetrieben wird. Wir testen und validieren unsere Produktversprechen, indem wir Athletenfeedback und wissenschaftliche Daten in marktführende Leistung verwandeln. Während unsere Kreationspartner daran arbeiten, Produkte großartig zu machen, ist unsere Mission es, zu beweisen, dass sie großartig sind. Unser Team aus Schuh-, Bekleidungs- und Zubehörartikeln und Lab-Experten mit Sitz in Zürich ist das ultimative Ziel für Einzelpersonen, die sich der Verbesserung der Verbrauchererfahrung widmen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref

Les tests de produit sont la voix de l'athlète et du consommateur chez On. Nous nous assurons que chaque produit offre une expérience premium et haute performance en combinant la rigueur scientifique avec la vision du monde réel.

En tant que chef de test Apparel et Accessoires, vous serez responsable de la validation des produits du développement au marché, en mettant l'accent sur les catégories de sport spécialisées et de haute performance. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement collaboratif et rapide et agirez comme partenaire clé dans la conception, le développement, les matériaux et la stratégie pour assurer l'excellence dans l'expérience de port, y compris le confort, la durabilité et la performance.

Votre mission

Commandez la stratégie de validation : Définissez et exécutez des stratégies de test rigoureuses pour la durabilité, le confort et la performance, en prenant en charge des programmes de test spécialisés. Vous identifierez les exigences de test en fonction des dossiers de produit et des consommateurs cibles, en possédant avec confiance le processus de test de bout en bout.

Découvrez la vérité dans les données : Tests qualitatifs et quantitatifs de vêtements et accessoires, études de perception et validation du monde réel pour s'assurer que nos produits reflètent les besoins authentiques des athlètes et des consommateurs.

Conduire les décisions de confiance : Transférer les résultats de tests complexes en des idées puissantes qui permettent de prendre des décisions confiantes et d'élever l'excellence des produits dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Influence Création de produits : Effectuez des essais pratiques de performance, en présentant directement les principales constatations et les recommandations d'amélioration aux intervenants critiques.

Construisez l'écosystème de test : établissez des processus de test, des délais et des boucles de rétroaction très efficaces et alignés de façon transparente sur les calendriers de création de produits. Vous créerez et maintenirez activement un réseau dynamique d'athlètes de haute performance et d'athlètes de valence qui répondent aux besoins quotidiens des tests et aux délais urgents des projets.

Des opérations élevées : Travaillez de façon transparente avec les systèmes et bases de données de test pour assurer des données précises et de haute qualité et des flux de rapports optimisés. En tant que leader, vous contribuerez de façon significative aux objectifs de l'équipe, aux améliorations de processus et à l'évolution continue de nos méthodes de test.

Votre histoire

• Un penseur stratégique et un leader naturel ayant fait ses preuves dans la gestion de projets complexes ou de cycles de validation de produits d'un concept à l'autre.

• Vous avez une compréhension approfondie des vêtements et accessoires sportifs spécialisés et de haute performance, et savez équilibrer la rigueur scientifique des tests avec la rétroaction humaine réelle.

• Vous êtes un interlocuteur exceptionnel qui peut traduire des données denses et des mesures de test en recommandations claires et réalisables aux équipes interfonctionnelles

• Vous êtes hautement organisé et capable de construire des réseaux robustes de investigation, d'établir des processus efficaces et de gérer la logistique de test globale.

• Vous avez 7 ans et plus d'expérience dans un domaine axé sur l'expérience humaine avec un produit ou un service. Nous sommes impatients d'entendre des candidats de divers horizons, y compris, mais non exclusivement:

• Essai ou développement de produits Apparel

• Recherche sur l'expérience utilisateur (UXR)

• Biomécanique ou Kinésiologie

• Science des matériaux ou génie textile

• Ergonomie ou facteurs humains

• Marketing sportif ou gestion des athlètes

• Coaching haute performance

• Vous êtes prêt à voyager dans le monde entier et avez la flexibilité de travailler en dehors des heures normales pour vous aligner sur les horaires et les événements des athlètes.

• Un communicateur clair en anglais, à la fois verbal et écrit.

Votre équipe

Nous testons et valideons nos promesses de produits, transformant les retours d'expérience et les données scientifiques des athlètes en performances de pointe sur le marché. Nos partenaires de création travaillent pour faire de grands produits, mais notre mission est de prouver qu'ils sont excellents. Basés à Zurich, notre équipe de Chaussures, Apparel & Accessoires et Lab experts est la destination ultime pour les personnes dédiées à améliorer l'expérience du consommateur.

jobs.title: Lead - Apparel Graphic Design
jobs.description:
In short:

This graphic apparel design opportunity will lead the graphic vision of tomorrow’s high performance athlete and lifestyle apparel. With a high-quality and detail oriented mind coupled with a passion for cultural relevancy and innovation, this role will be integral in On’s success in performance.

Your Mission:

• Create and lead a strong contemporary graphic story telling, coupled with mood, research, and design through all aspects of print/graphic for apparel along with your Apparel Design Lead.

• Lead graphic presentations with internal and external partners.

• Research of imagery and references in regards to vision, materialisation, colour compositions, detailing, brand direction and all other aspects of graphics for your collections.

• Sketch to visualise quick ideas of graphic direction, including 3D mock ups.

• Create graphic tech packs and detailed artworks for your Development team player.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders in marketing, development, innovation and our partners in Asia

• Research and help sourcing innovative, upscale materials and trims to elevate your graphics.

• Champion processes, constantly improving, tweaking and building upon the current process.

• Set and reach goals to increase both individual and team productivity.

• Travel to visit partners and vendors around the world

Your Story:

• Bachelor’s degree or above in graphic design.

• Minimum of 9 years experience in graphic design with a focus on apparel graphic design. Performance sportswear a plus

• Excellent level of technical skills is a must, such as print techniques, material graphic design, story telling, branding.

• Broad market overview and a good sense for the contemporary design world, and culture shifts.

• Structured and hands-on working attitude with a flexible and open mind for visionary solutions

• Expert skills in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop & Microsoft Office.

• International experience is a must

• Excellent communication and presentation skills with fluent English spoken and written

Your Team:

We continue to push boundaries and disrupt performance apparel through innovative thinking and execution. We strive for excellence in our product, working with athletes to validate what we do.

jobs.title: Lead - Anaplan Model Builder
jobs.description:
In short

On is looking for a Lead Anaplan Specialist (Anaplan Model Builder / Solution Architect) to join On at its HQ in Zurich.

We are excited to offer these roles to driven team players with exceptional problem-solving skills and the mindset to leverage their own ideas and bring new initiatives to life. You will work in an environment where we make ideas happen fast as you take responsibility for building, maintaining, and further developing both backend and frontend of our Anaplan solutions with a main focus on Financial Planning. With your proven technical expertise and understanding of enterprise planning processes, you will contribute to setting up a robust planning system environment which comes with great opportunities to grow in your position!

Your Mission

• Technical ownership of planning models as Anaplan Solution Architect / Model Builder, responsibility for backend/frontend building activities as well as integrations to other systems and Anaplan models.

• Ownership of Anaplan initiatives and projects end-to-end (requirements engineering, model building, testing, go-live support, maintenance).

jobs.title: Lead - Accessories Developer (Technical) Bags
jobs.description:
In short
 The Lead Accessories Developer - (Technical) Bags will report to the Lead - Accessories Development on the Accessories team supporting the Global Product function. You will be the technical engine behind the bags technical range. Your mission is to translate complex designs into market ready products through expert product development, precise sizing architecture, and superior technical construction.

Your mission
 - Deliver exceptional product quality by merging innovative manufacturing techniques with early-stage material explorations to develop novel construction methods.
- Partner closely with the Materials team to leverage their early-stage material explorations. Select and apply fabrics, trims, and components based on hard performance data and functional requirements rather than aesthetic appeal alone.
- Move beyond standard 2D/3D documentation by physically validating concepts through hands-on prototyping. Build and manipulate physical samples to prove the feasibility and functional logic of new construction methods before engaging external suppliers.
- Ensure all early-stage concepts function harmoniously with the human body in motion. Validate fit, sizing, and ergonomics through a biomechanical lens to optimize performance and comfort.
- Conduct rigorous testing and risk analysis on new constructions to identify and correct potential failure points before projects transition to the main development cycle.
- The "Golden Standard": Create, refine, and enforce a flawless standard for detailed Technical Packages (Tech Packs) and Bill of Materials (BOMs) within the PLM system.
- Critical Path Ownership: Manage the overarching product development calendar, tracking milestones closely to ensure the timely delivery of seasonal ranges.
- Build and leverage strategic relationships with both domestic and overseas suppliers. Negotiate product costs and implement strict quality assurance practices to optimize margins without compromising the product's integrity.
- Work dynamically with manufacturing partners to streamline and improve sample turnaround times, resolving production bottlenecks proactively.
- Act as a technical mentor to junior development staff, fostering an environment of continuous learning, technical excellence, and curiosity.
- Guide cross-functional teams (Design, Product Management, and Sourcing) to align on product execution and establish strategic external partnerships that introduce new, industry-first market differentiators.

Your story
 - Deep Specialization: You bring 10+ years of experience dedicated exclusively to the development of accessories focused on technical bags.
- Performance Expertise: You have a proven track record in sports and high-end performance gear, understanding the rigors of athletic use.
- Technical Bags and Packs Background: Extensive experience in performance and technical bags and packs is highly desirable.
- Multi-Product Mastery: You are an expert in developing varied silhouettes.
- Analytical Design: Proficient in translating 2D design concepts into 3D performance realities using advanced PLM systems and Adobe Illustrator.
- Global Sourcing: Experience collaborating with world-class manufacturers to push the boundaries of performance textile innovation.
- Meticulous attention to detail regarding measurements, tolerances, and material specifications.
- A constant drive to explore new yarn technologies and construction methods to solve problems.
- A proactive approach to troubleshooting fit and construction issues during the development phase.

Meet the team
 You will join a dynamic, cross-functional team dedicated to redefining accessories. We are a group of specialists who value technical rigor, aesthetic elevation, and challenge the Status Quo mindset. Our team operates at the intersection of high-end fashion and elite sport, moving fast to turn innovative ideas into premium products.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve
Il Lead Accessories Developer - (Technical) Bags riferirà al Lead - Accessori Development sul team Accessori che supporta la funzione Global Product. Sarete il motore tecnico dietro la gamma tecnica borse. La vostra missione è di tradurre disegni complessi in prodotti pronti al mercato attraverso lo sviluppo di prodotti esperti, l'architettura di dimensionamento precisa e la costruzione tecnica superiore.

La tua missione
- Fornire un'eccezionale qualità del prodotto fondendo tecniche di produzione innovative con esplorazioni materiali di prima fase per sviluppare nuovi metodi di costruzione.
- Collabora a stretto contatto con il team Materials per sfruttare le loro esplorazioni materiali di prima fase. Selezionare e applicare tessuti, finiture e componenti in base a dati di prestazioni dure e requisiti funzionali piuttosto che appeal estetico da solo.
- Spostarsi oltre la documentazione standard 2D/3D convalidando fisicamente i concetti attraverso la prototipazione hands-on. Costruire e manipolare campioni fisici per dimostrare la fattibilità e la logica funzionale di nuovi metodi di costruzione prima di coinvolgere fornitori esterni.
- Assicurarsi che tutti i concetti del primo stadio funzionino armoniosamente con il corpo umano in movimento. Convalida vestibilità, dimensionamento ed ergonomia attraverso una lente biomeccanica per ottimizzare le prestazioni e il comfort.
- Condurre test rigorosi e analisi dei rischi su nuove costruzioni per identificare e correggere i potenziali punti di fallimento prima della transizione dei progetti al ciclo di sviluppo principale.
- Il "Golden Standard": Crea, affina e applica uno standard impeccabile per i pacchetti tecnici dettagliati (Tech Packs) e Bill of Materials (BOMs) all'interno del sistema PLM.
- Critical Path Ownership: Gestisci il calendario di sviluppo del prodotto overarching, tracciando pietre miliari da vicino per garantire la consegna tempestiva di intervalli stagionali.
- Costruire e sfruttare le relazioni strategiche con fornitori sia nazionali che esteri. Negoziare i costi del prodotto e implementare rigide pratiche di garanzia della qualità per ottimizzare i margini senza compromettere l'integrità del prodotto.
- Lavorare dinamicamente con i partner di produzione per ottimizzare e migliorare i tempi di turnaround del campione, risolvendo i colli di bottiglia di produzione in modo proattivo.
- Agire come mentore tecnico al personale di sviluppo junior, promuovere un ambiente di apprendimento continuo, eccellenza tecnica e curiosità.
- Guida i team interfunzionali (Design, Product Management e Sourcing) per allineare l'esecuzione del prodotto e stabilire partnership esterne strategiche che introducono nuovi differenziatori di mercato leader nel settore.

La tua storia
- Deep Specialization: Porti 10+ anni di esperienza dedicata esclusivamente allo sviluppo di accessori focalizzati sulle borse tecniche.
- Performance Expertise: Hai una comprovata esperienza nel settore dello sport e dell'alta prestazione, comprendendo i rigori dell'uso atletico.
- Borse Tecniche e Pacchetti Background: Ampia esperienza nelle prestazioni e sacchetti tecnici e confezioni è altamente desiderabile.
- Multi-Product Mastery: Sei un esperto nello sviluppo di diverse silhouette.
- Design analitico: Proficiente nel tradurre i concetti di design 2D in realtà di performance 3D utilizzando sistemi PLM avanzati e Adobe Illustrator.
- Global Sourcing: Esperienza di collaborazione con produttori di livello mondiale per spingere i confini dell'innovazione tessile delle prestazioni.
- Meticolosa attenzione ai dettagli per quanto riguarda le misure, le tolleranze e le specifiche dei materiali.
- Un costante tentativo di esplorare nuove tecnologie di filato e metodi di costruzione per risolvere i problemi.
- Un approccio proattivo per risolvere i problemi di vestibilità e costruzione durante la fase di sviluppo.

Incontra la squadra
Unisciti a un team dinamico e interfunzionale dedicato alla ridefinizione degli accessori. Siamo un gruppo di specialisti che apprezzano rigore tecnico, elevazione estetica e sfidano la mentalità Status Quo. Il nostro team opera all'incrocio tra moda di fascia alta e sport d'elite, muovendosi velocemente per trasformare idee innovative in prodotti premium.

Cosa offriamo
Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico - per rimanere attivo, imparare, esplorare e innovare. Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera solida e orientata al team, con l'accesso all'autocura personale sia per il benessere fisico che mentale, quindi ogni persona è guidata dallo scopo.

Su è una parità di opportunità datori di lavoro. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, all'avanzamento e alla conservazione sono libere di discriminazione.

- Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Frühphasenkonzepte harmonisch mit dem menschlichen Körper in Bewegung funktionieren. Validieren Sie Passform, Größe und Ergonomie durch eine biomechanische Linse, um Leistung und Komfort zu optimieren.

- Der "Goldene Standard": Erstellen, Verfeinern und Erzwingen eines einwandfreien Standards für detaillierte technische Pakete (Tech Packs) und Stücklisten (BOMs) innerhalb des PLM-Systems.
